```
    58→function hasHigherZIndexDialog(): boolean {

    70→function targetHasHigherZIndex(target: EventTarget | null): boolean {

    72→  while (element && element !== document.body) {

   354→      : needsFullscreenLayout

   356→      : {}),

   363→        modal={isActuallyModal}
   364→        disablePointerDismissal
```

```
1→import { useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→
     3→export interface UseLightboxNavigationProps {
     4→  onNext?: () => void;
     5→  onPrevious?: () => void;

     9→export interface UseLightboxNavigationReturn {

    13→
    14→/**
    15→ * Hook for managing lightbox navigation
    16→ * Handles keyboard controls (arrow keys, escape) and safe closing with click shield
    17→ */
    18→export const useLightboxNavigation = ({
    19→  onNext,
    20→  onPrevious,
    21→  onClose,
    22→}: UseLightboxNavigationProps): UseLightboxNavigationReturn => {
    23→  
    24→  // Short-lived global click shield to absorb iOS synthetic clicks after touchend
    25→  const activateClickShield = useCallback(() => {
    26→    try {
    27→      const shield = document.createElement('div');
    28→      shield.setAttribute('data-mobile-click-shield', 'true');
    29→      shield.style.position = 'fixed';
    30→      shield.style.top = '0';
    31→      shield.style.left = '0';
    32→      shield.style.right = '0';
    33→      shield.style.bottom = '0';
    34→      shield.style.background = 'transparent';
    35→      shield.style.pointerEvents = 'all';
    36→      shield.style.zIndex = '2147483647';
    37→      shield.style.touchAction = 'none';
    38→
    39→      const block = (ev: Event) => {
    40→        try { ev.preventDefault(); } catch {}
    41→        try { ev.stopPropagation(); } catch {}
    42→        try { ev.stopImmediatePropagation?.(); } catch {}
    43→      };
    44→
    45→      shield.addEventListener('click', block, true);
    46→      shield.addEventListener('pointerdown', block, true);
    47→      shield.addEventListener('pointerup', block, true);
    48→      shield.addEventListener('touchstart', block, { capture: true, passive: false } as AddEventListenerOptions);
    49→      shield.addEventListener('touchend', block, { capture: true, passive: false } as AddEventListenerOptions);
    50→
    51→      document.body.appendChild(shield);
    52→
    53→      window.setTimeout(() => {
    54→        try { shield.remove(); } catch {}
    55→      }, 350);
    56→    } catch {}
    57→  }, []);
    58→
    59→  const safeClose = useCallback(() => {
    60→    activateClickShield();
    61→    onClose();
    62→  }, [activateClickShield, onClose]);
    63→
    64→  /**
    65→   * Global key handler
    66→   * --------------------------------------------------
    67→   * We register a document-level keydown listener so that
    68→   * arrow navigation still works even when an embedded
    69→   * <video> element (which is focusable) steals keyboard
    70→   * focus.
    71→   * 
    72→   * IMPORTANT: Don't handle keys if another dialog is open on top
    73→   */
    74→  useEffect(() => {
    75→    const handleWindowKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    76→      // Check if another dialog/modal is open on top by looking for higher z-index dialog overlays
    77→      const dialogOverlays = document.querySelectorAll('[data-dialog-backdrop]');
    78→      const hasHigherZIndexDialog = Array.from(dialogOverlays).some((overlay) => {
    79→        const zIndex = parseInt(window.getComputedStyle(overlay as Element).zIndex || '0', 10);
    80→        // MediaLightbox uses z-[100000], check if any higher z-index dialogs are open
    81→        return zIndex > 100000;
    82→      });
    83→
    84→      // Don't handle keys if a higher z-index dialog is open
    85→      if (hasHigherZIndexDialog) {
    86→        return;
    87→      }
    88→
    89→      // Check if user is currently typing in a text input field
    90→      const activeElement = document.activeElement;
    91→      const isTyping = activeElement && (
    92→        activeElement.tagName === 'INPUT' ||
    93→        activeElement.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ||
    94→        (activeElement as HTMLElement).contentEditable === 'true' ||
    95→        (activeElement as HTMLElement).isContentEditable
    96→      );
    97→
    98→      // Don't handle arrow keys if user is typing (but still handle Escape)
    99→      if (isTyping && (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowRight')) {
   100→        return;
   101→      }
   102→
   103→      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && onPrevious) {
   104→        e.preventDefault();
   105→        onPrevious();
   106→      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && onNext) {
   107→        e.preventDefault();
   108→        onNext();
   109→      } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
   110→        e.preventDefault();
   111→        onClose();
   112→      }
   113→    };
   114→
   115→    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleWindowKeyDown);
   116→    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleWindowKeyDown);
   117→  }, [onNext, onPrevious, onClose]);
   118→
   119→  return {
   120→    safeClose,
   121→    activateClickShield,
   122→  };
   123→};
```

## Lightbox Implementation - Fixed Positioning, Touch-Action, and Viewport Handling

Based on my thorough exploration of the codebase, here's a complete breakdown of how the lightbox is implemented with respect to fixed positioning, touch-action, and viewport/keyboard handling:

### Core Architecture Files

**1. LightboxShell.tsx** - `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/components/LightboxShell.tsx`
- **Purpose**: Main dialog/overlay container handling all modal behavior
- **Key Features**:
  - Uses `DialogPrimitive.Root` with `modal={isActuallyModal}` (true on phones only)
  - Manual body scroll locking for tablet/desktop (see scroll locking section below)
  - Touch-action and pointer event management
  - Z-index hierarchy (10000 for overlay, 10000 for content)

**2. LightboxLayout.tsx** - `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/components/layouts/LightboxLayout.tsx`
- **Purpose**: Unified layout for all lightbox configurations (desktop side-panel, mobile stacked, centered)
- **Key Classes**: `touch-none` and `touch-pan-y` for swipe navigation

### Fixed Positioning & CSS Strategy

#### Overlay Styling (in LightboxShell.tsx, lines 323-340):
```
const overlayStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  pointerEvents: 'all',
  touchAction: 'none',
  cursor: 'pointer', // Required for iOS touch events
  zIndex: 10000,
  position: 'fixed',
  top: 0,
  left: 0,
  right: shouldAccountForTasksPane ? `${effectiveTasksPaneWidth}px` : 0,
  bottom: 0,
  // Use inset (top/bottom: 0) for height instead of 100dvh.
  // 100dvh changes dynamically on iOS Safari as the address bar shows/hides,
  // causing the lightbox to resize and leave gaps.
  transition: 'right 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), width 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)',
  ...(shouldAccountForTasksPane
    ? { width: `calc(100vw - ${effectiveTasksPaneWidth}px)` }
    : {}),
};
```

**Key Insights**:
- Uses `position: fixed` with inset values (`top: 0, left: 0, right: X, bottom: 0`) instead of `100dvh`
- **Avoids 100dvh/100vh because iOS Safari Safari address bar changes dynamically**, causing resize gaps
- Width calculated as `calc(100vw - paneWidth)` for tablet with tasks pane
- **touch-action: 'none'** prevents default browser touch behaviors

#### Content Styling (lines 350-357):
```
const contentStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  transition: 'width 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)',
  ...(needsTasksPaneOffset
    ? { width: `calc(100vw - ${effectiveTasksPaneWidth}px)` }
    : needsFullscreenLayout
    ? { width: '100vw' }
    : {}),
};
```

#### Popup Classes (line 413-415):
```

  ? "inset-0 w-full h-full"
  : "left-[50%] top-[50%] translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%] w-auto h-auto ..."
```

### Touch-Action & Event Handling

#### Touch-Action Usage:
1. **Overlay**: `touchAction: 'none'` (line 325) - prevents all default touch behaviors
2. **Click Shield** (useLightboxNavigation.ts, line 37): Temporary fixed overlay with `touchAction: 'none'` to absorb synthetic clicks after touchend on iOS

#### Touch Event Handlers:
From LightboxShell.tsx (lines 296-308):
```tsx
const handleTouchEvent = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
  if (shouldAllowTouchThrough(e.target as HTMLElement, hasCanvasOverlay)) return;
  if (isMobile) e.stopPropagation();
};

const handleTouchCancel = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
  if (hasHigherZIndexDialog()) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopPropagation();
  if (e.nativeEvent && typeof e.nativeEvent.stopImmediatePropagation === 'function') {
    e.nativeEvent.stopImmediatePropagation();
  }
};
```

### Body Scroll Locking

From LightboxShell.tsx (lines 129-166):
```tsx
const isActuallyModal = isMobile && !isTabletOrLarger;
useEffect(() => {
  if (isActuallyModal) return; // modal={true} handles scroll locking

  const scrollY = window.scrollY;
  const body = document.body;
  const saved = {
    position: body.style.position,
    top: body.style.top,
    left: body.style.left,
    right: body.style.right,
    overflow: body.style.overflow,
    width: body.style.width,
  };

  body.style.position = 'fixed';
  body.style.top = `-${scrollY}px`;
  body.style.left = '0';
  body.style.right = '0';
  body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  body.style.width = '100%';

  return () => {
    body.style.position = saved.position;
    body.style.top = saved.top;
    body.style.left = saved.left;
    body.style.right = saved.right;
    body.style.overflow = saved.overflow;
    body.style.width = saved.width;
    window.scrollTo(0, scrollY);
  };
}, [isActuallyModal]);
```

**Strategy**:
- Phones use `modal={true}` (Base UI handles scroll)
- Tablet/Desktop use manual `position: fixed + top: -scrollY` to lock scroll without `overflow: hidden` alone
- On iOS Safari, `overflow: hidden` alone doesn't prevent touch-scroll, so position + offset is needed
- Position restored on cleanup

### Scroll Containment & Overflow

#### LightboxLayout.tsx (lines 449-454):

```tsx
  data-task-details-panel
  className={cn(
    "bg-background overflow-hidden relative z-[60] overscroll-contain",
    isDesktopPanel
      ? "border-l border-border h-full"
      : "border-t border-border overflow-y-auto"
  )}
```

**Classes**:
- **Desktop**: `overflow-hidden` (no scrolling in side panel)
- **Mobile**: `overflow-y-auto` (scrollable stacked layout)
- **Both**: `overscroll-contain` - prevents rubber-band scrolling on iOS

### Swipe Navigation & Touch-Action Classes

From LightboxLayout.tsx (lines 307-324):
```tsx
<div
  data-lightbox-bg
  className={cn(
    "flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden",
    isDesktopPanel
      ? "flex-1 touch-none"                          // Desktop: no touch gestures
      : "flex-none touch-pan-y z-10"                 // Mobile: allow vertical pan only
  )}
  style={isDesktopPanel
    ? { width: '60%' }
    : {
        height: '50%',
        transform: swipeNavigation.isSwiping ? `translateX(${swipeNavigation.swipeOffset}px)` : undefined,
        transition: swipeNavigation.isSwiping ? 'none' : 'transform 0.2s ease-out',
      }
  }
>
```

**Touch-Action Classes**:
- **`touch-none`** (desktop): `touch-action: none` - no default browser touch handling
- **`touch-pan-y`** (mobile stacked): `touch-action: pan-y` - allows vertical scroll, disables pinch/rotation

### Keyboard Handling

#### useLightboxNavigation.ts (lines 74-117)

Features:
1. **Document-level keydown listener** so arrow keys work even when `<video>` steals focus
2. **Escape key**: Always closes lightbox
3. **Arrow keys**: Navigate previous/next (only if not typing)
4. **Z-index awareness**: Checks for higher z-index dialogs (z > 100000)
5. **Typing detection**: Skips arrow keys if `activeElement` is INPUT/TEXTAREA/contentEditable

#### SegmentSlotFormView (lines 143-165)

Special keyboard nav for form-only mode:
- **Tab**: Navigate to next segment (prevented if at end)
- **Shift+Tab**: Navigate to previous segment
- **Arrow Right**: Navigate next
- **Arrow Left**: Navigate previous
- **Exemption**: Doesn't intercept if user typing in TEXTAREA

### iOS Keyboard-Specific Handling

**Critical Points**:
1. **No visual viewport tracking** - The code intentionally avoids `visualViewport` API and instead:
   - Uses `inset-0` (top/bottom: 0) instead of `100dvh`
   - Lets iOS Safari naturally handle keyboard show/hide
   - Body scroll locking uses absolute positioning, which is unaffected by keyboard height

2. **Click Shield (useLightboxNavigation.ts, lines 24-57)**:
   - Creates temporary fixed overlay with `touchAction: 'none'`
   - Blocks synthetic click event (350ms after touchend) on iOS
   - Auto-removes after 350ms
   - Prevents accidental modal close after touch navigation

### Z-Index Hierarchy

- **100001**: Tasks pane control tab (PaneControlTab)
- **100000**: Lightbox backdrop & content (Backdrop & Popup)
- **10000**: Overlay (internal, rarely visible)
- **60**: Info panel in side-by-side layout

### Responsive Classes

From LightboxLayout.tsx (lines 138-156):
```tsx
const isSidePanelLayout = showPanel && shouldShowSidePanel;  // Side-by-side (tablet+)
const isStackedLayout = showPanel && !shouldShowSidePanel;   // Stacked (mobile/portrait)

const mediaDisplayVariant = showPanel
  ? (isSidePanelLayout ? 'desktop-side-panel' : 'mobile-stacked')
  : 'regular-centered';
```

## Summary

The lightbox uses a sophisticated fixed-positioning strategy optimized for iOS:
- **Avoids 100dvh** in favor of `inset-0` + `fixed` to prevent keyboard-related resizing
- **Manual body scroll locking** on tablet/desktop instead of relying on modal
- **touch-action: none** on overlay, with `touch-pan-y` for swipeable content
- **Click shield** (350ms temporary overlay) to absorb iOS synthetic clicks
- **overscroll-contain** on scrollable panels to prevent rubber-band scrolling
- **Document-level keyboard handlers** for Escape and arrow navigation
- **No visual viewport tracking** - lets iOS handle keyboard naturally

All files are in `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/` with key files being:
- `LightboxShell.tsx` (positioning, scroll locking, touch events)
- `LightboxLayout.tsx` (swipe navigation, touch-action classes)
- `useLightboxNavigation.ts` (keyboard, click shield)

```
1→/**
     2→ * LightboxShell - Dialog/Overlay container for MediaLightbox
     3→ *
     4→ * Encapsulates all the complex event handling for the lightbox modal:
     5→ * - Dialog root/portal/overlay
     6→ * - Pointer/touch/click event handling with z-index awareness
     7→ * - Body scroll locking
     8→ * - Accessibility elements
     9→ *
    10→ * Note: Tasks pane controls are handled by the existing PaneControlTab from TasksPane,
    11→ * which is visible above the lightbox at z-[100001]. The overlay adjusts its size
    12→ * to account for the pane when it's open or locked.
    13→ *
    14→ * This allows the main MediaLightbox to focus on content orchestration.
    15→ */
    16→
    17→import React, { useRef, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
    18→import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "@base-ui-components/react/dialog";
    19→import { TooltipProvider } from '@/shared/components/ui/tooltip';
    20→import { cn } from '@/shared/lib/utils';
    21→
    22→interface LightboxShellProps {
    23→  children: React.ReactNode;
    24→  onClose: () => void;
    25→
    26→  // Edit mode
    27→  /** Canvas/brush edit overlay is active (inpaint, annotate, reposition, text).
    28→   *  Used to allow canvas touch events to pass through. */
    29→  hasCanvasOverlay: boolean;
    30→  /** Reposition (move) mode — the only edit mode that blocks background click-to-close
    31→   *  (because dragging could cause accidental closes). */
    32→  isRepositionMode: boolean;
    33→
    34→  // Responsive
    35→  isMobile: boolean;
    36→  isTabletOrLarger: boolean;
    37→
    38→  // Tasks pane (for overlay/content sizing)

    42→
    43→  // Layout
    44→  needsFullscreenLayout: boolean;

    48→  contentRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>;

    51→  accessibilityTitle: string;
    52→  accessibilityDescription: string;
    53→}
    54→
    55→/**
    56→ * Helper to check if a higher z-index dialog is open
    57→ */
    58→function hasHigherZIndexDialog(): boolean {
    59→  // Query for our custom compat attribute on dialog overlays/backdrops
    60→  const dialogOverlays = document.querySelectorAll('[data-dialog-backdrop]');
    61→  return Array.from(dialogOverlays).some((overlay) => {
    62→    const zIndex = parseInt(window.getComputedStyle(overlay as Element).zIndex || '0', 10);
    63→    return zIndex > 100000;
    64→  });
    65→}
    66→
    67→/**
    68→ * Helper to check if target or any ancestor has higher z-index
    69→ */
    70→function targetHasHigherZIndex(target: EventTarget | null): boolean {
    71→  let element = target as HTMLElement | null;
    72→  while (element && element !== document.body) {
    73→    const zIndex = parseInt(window.getComputedStyle(element).zIndex || '0', 10);
    74→    if (zIndex > 100000) {
    75→      return true;
    76→    }
    77→    element = element.parentElement;
    78→  }
    79→  return false;
    80→}
    81→
    82→/**
    83→ * Helper to check if element is interactive (buttons, inputs, etc.)
    84→ */
    85→function isInteractiveElement(target: HTMLElement): boolean {
    86→  return (
    87→    target.tagName === 'BUTTON' ||
    88→    target.tagName === 'INPUT' ||
    89→    target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ||
    90→    target.tagName === 'SELECT' ||
    91→    target.tagName === 'A' ||
    92→    target.closest('button') !== null ||
    93→    target.closest('a') !== null
    94→  );
    95→}
    96→
    97→/**
    98→ * Check if a touch event should pass through to the element
    99→ * (canvas in edit mode, or interactive elements like buttons/inputs).
   100→ */
   101→function shouldAllowTouchThrough(target: HTMLElement, hasCanvasOverlay: boolean): boolean {
   102→  if (hasCanvasOverlay && target.tagName === 'CANVAS') return true;
   103→  if (isInteractiveElement(target)) return true;
   104→  return false;
   105→}
   106→
   107→/**
   108→ * Track the visual viewport — the area actually visible to the user.
   109→ * On iOS Safari, the on-screen keyboard shifts the visual viewport without
   110→ * resizing the layout viewport.  Fixed elements anchored to the layout viewport
   111→ * appear to shift.  By tracking visualViewport we can size the overlay to match
   112→ * what's actually visible, working *with* the keyboard rather than fighting it.
   113→ */
   114→function useVisualViewport() {
   115→  const [rect, setRect] = useState(() => ({
   116→    offsetTop: 0,
   117→    height: window.visualViewport?.height ?? window.innerHeight,
   118→  }));
   119→
   120→  useEffect(() => {
   121→    const vv = window.visualViewport;
   122→    if (!vv) return;
   123→
   124→    const update = () => {
   125→      setRect({ offsetTop: vv.offsetTop, height: vv.height });
   126→    };
   127→
   128→    vv.addEventListener('resize', update);
   129→    vv.addEventListener('scroll', update);
   130→    update();
   131→
   132→    return () => {
   133→      vv.removeEventListener('resize', update);
   134→      vv.removeEventListener('scroll', update);
   135→    };
   136→  }, []);
   137→
   138→  return rect;
   139→}
   140→
   141→export const LightboxShell: React.FC<LightboxShellProps> = ({
   142→  children,
   143→  onClose,
   144→  hasCanvasOverlay,
   145→  isRepositionMode,
   146→  isMobile,
   147→  isTabletOrLarger,
   148→  effectiveTasksPaneOpen,
   149→  effectiveTasksPaneWidth,
   150→  isTasksPaneLocked,
   151→  needsFullscreenLayout,
   152→  needsTasksPaneOffset,
   153→  contentRef,
   154→  accessibilityTitle,
   155→  accessibilityDescription,
   156→}) => {
   157→  // Visual viewport tracking — overlay matches the actual visible area
   158→  const { offsetTop: vvTop, height: vvHeight } = useVisualViewport();
   159→
   160→  // Track where pointer/click started to prevent accidental modal closure on drag
   161→  const pointerDownTargetRef = useRef<EventTarget | null>(null);
   162→
   163→  // Track pointerdown target for capture-phase background click detection
   164→  const bgPointerDownTargetRef = useRef<EventTarget | null>(null);

   166→  // Lock body scroll when lightbox is open.
   167→  // On phones, modal={true} handles scroll locking. On desktop and iPad,
   168→  // modal={false} (to allow TasksPane interaction), so we lock manually.
   169→  // We use position:fixed on body + scroll-position save/restore so that:
   170→  //   1. iOS Safari can't touch-scroll the body (overflow:hidden alone doesn't work)
   171→  //   2. The body scroll state is always clean between lightbox open/close cycles
   172→  const isActuallyModal = isMobile && !isTabletOrLarger;
   173→  useEffect(() => {
   174→    if (isActuallyModal) return; // modal={true} handles scroll locking
   175→
   176→    const scrollY = window.scrollY;
   177→    const body = document.body;
   178→    const saved = {
   179→      position: body.style.position,
   180→      top: body.style.top,
   181→      left: body.style.left,
   182→      right: body.style.right,
   183→      overflow: body.style.overflow,
   184→      width: body.style.width,
   185→    };
   186→
   187→    body.style.position = 'fixed';
   188→    body.style.top = `-${scrollY}px`;
   189→    body.style.left = '0';
   190→    body.style.right = '0';
   191→    body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
   192→    body.style.width = '100%';
   193→
   194→    return () => {
   195→      // Dismiss the on-screen keyboard before restoring scroll position.
   196→      // If the keyboard is still up, the visual viewport offset persists and
   197→      // corrupts the scroll restore, causing dirty state across lightbox cycles.
   198→      if (document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement) {
   199→        document.activeElement.blur();
   200→      }
   201→      body.style.position = saved.position;
   202→      body.style.top = saved.top;
   203→      body.style.left = saved.left;
   204→      body.style.right = saved.right;
   205→      body.style.overflow = saved.overflow;
   206→      body.style.width = saved.width;

   215→  // In fullscreen layouts the Popup covers the Backdrop, so these don't fire —

   239→    // Pointer events still fire, so we detect a "click" as pointerdown +
   240→    // pointerup on the same overlay element.
   241→    if (!isRepositionMode) {
   242→      const clickStartedOnOverlay = pointerDownTargetRef.current === e.currentTarget;
   243→      const clickEndedOnOverlay = e.target === e.currentTarget;
   244→
   245→      if (clickStartedOnOverlay && clickEndedOnOverlay) {
   246→        onClose();
   247→      }
   248→    }
   249→
   250→    pointerDownTargetRef.current = null;
   251→
   252→    e.preventDefault();
   253→    e.stopPropagation();
   254→    if (e.nativeEvent && typeof e.nativeEvent.stopImmediatePropagation === 'function') {
   255→      e.nativeEvent.stopImmediatePropagation();
   256→    }
   257→  };
   258→
   259→  const handleOverlayClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
   260→    if (hasHigherZIndexDialog() || targetHasHigherZIndex(e.target)) {
   261→      return;
   262→    }
   263→
   264→    // Primary close logic is in handleOverlayPointerUp (see comment there).
   265→    // This handler is a fallback for any edge cases where click still fires.
   266→    if (isRepositionMode) {
   267→      pointerDownTargetRef.current = null;
   268→      return;
   269→    }
   270→
   271→    const clickStartedOnOverlay = pointerDownTargetRef.current === e.currentTarget;
   272→    const clickEndedOnOverlay = e.target === e.currentTarget;
   273→
   274→    if (clickStartedOnOverlay && clickEndedOnOverlay) {
   275→      onClose();
   276→    }
   277→
   278→    pointerDownTargetRef.current = null;
   279→  };
   280→
   281→  // ========================================
   282→  // STANDARDIZED BACKGROUND CLICK-TO-CLOSE
   283→  // ========================================
   284→  // Uses capture phase on the Popup so it fires before any child handler.
   285→  // Layouts mark their background elements with data-lightbox-bg.
   286→  // This is the ONE place that handles click-to-close for all layouts.
   287→
   288→  const handleBgPointerDownCapture = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
   289→    bgPointerDownTargetRef.current = e.target;
   290→  };
   291→
   292→  const handleBgClickCapture = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
   293→    const downTarget = bgPointerDownTargetRef.current as HTMLElement | null;
   294→    const upTarget = e.target as HTMLElement;
   295→    bgPointerDownTargetRef.current = null;
   296→
   297→    if (hasHigherZIndexDialog() || targetHasHigherZIndex(upTarget)) return;
   298→    // Only reposition mode blocks background close (dragging could cause accidental closes).
   299→    // All other edit modes (inpaint, annotate, magic edit, etc.) allow background close.
   300→    if (isRepositionMode) return;
   301→
   302→    // Both pointerdown and click must land directly on a background element
   303→    // (not on a child of one — the target itself must have the attribute)
   304→    if (
   305→      downTarget?.hasAttribute?.('data-lightbox-bg') &&
   306→      upTarget.hasAttribute?.('data-lightbox-bg')
   307→    ) {
   308→      e.stopPropagation();
   309→      onClose();
   310→    }
   311→  };
   312→
   313→  // ========================================
   314→  // CONTENT EVENT HANDLERS
   315→  // ========================================
   316→
   317→  const handleContentPointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
   318→    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
   319→    // Don't stop propagation for floating UI content (selects, popovers, menus)
   320→    const isFloatingContent = target.closest('[role="listbox"], [role="menu"], [data-side], [data-popup]') !== null;
   321→
   322→    if (isFloatingContent) {
   323→      return;
   324→    }
   325→
   326→    e.stopPropagation();
   327→  };
   328→
   329→  const handleContentClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
   330→    e.stopPropagation();
   331→  };
   332→
   333→  // ========================================
   334→  // SHARED TOUCH HANDLERS (Backdrop + Popup)
   335→  // ========================================
   336→  // Used on both layers. Allow canvas/interactive element touches through;
   337→  // otherwise stop propagation on mobile to prevent Base UI interference.
   338→
   339→  const handleTouchEvent = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
   340→    if (shouldAllowTouchThrough(e.target as HTMLElement, hasCanvasOverlay)) return;
   341→    if (isMobile) e.stopPropagation();
   342→  };
   343→
   344→  const handleTouchCancel = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
   345→    if (hasHigherZIndexDialog()) return;
   346→    e.preventDefault();
   347→    e.stopPropagation();
   348→    if (e.nativeEvent && typeof e.nativeEvent.stopImmediatePropagation === 'function') {
   349→      e.nativeEvent.stopImmediatePropagation();
   350→    }
   351→  };
   352→
   353→  // Focus the content element on mount
   354→  useEffect(() => {
   355→    contentRef.current?.focus();
   356→  }, [contentRef]);
   357→
   358→  // ========================================
   359→  // OVERLAY STYLES
   360→  // ========================================
   361→
   362→  // Check both effectiveTasksPaneOpen AND isTasksPaneLocked to handle edge cases
   363→  // where they might be temporarily out of sync (e.g., during hydration)
   364→  const shouldAccountForTasksPane = (effectiveTasksPaneOpen || isTasksPaneLocked) && isTabletOrLarger;
   365→
   366→  // Backdrop covers the entire layout viewport (always dark, no gaps).
   367→  // Only the Popup content tracks the visual viewport — see contentStyle.
   368→  const overlayStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
   369→    pointerEvents: 'all',
   370→    touchAction: 'none',
   371→    cursor: 'pointer', // Required for iOS touch events
   372→    zIndex: 10000,
   373→    position: 'fixed',
   374→    top: 0,
   375→    left: 0,
   376→    right: shouldAccountForTasksPane ? `${effectiveTasksPaneWidth}px` : 0,
   377→    bottom: 0,
   378→    transition: 'right 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), width 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)',
   379→    ...(shouldAccountForTasksPane
   380→      ? { width: `calc(100vw - ${effectiveTasksPaneWidth}px)` }
   381→      : {}),
   382→  };
   383→
   384→  // ========================================
   385→  // CONTENT STYLES
   386→  // ========================================
   387→
   388→  // Content tracks the visual viewport ONLY when the keyboard causes an offset.
   389→  // visualViewport.offsetTop > 0 means iOS has shifted the visual viewport
   390→  // (keyboard appeared with position:fixed body). In that case, position the
   391→  // content to match the visible area.  Otherwise use inset: 0 (full layout
   392→  // viewport) — visualViewport.height differs from layout viewport height due
   393→  // to the address bar, so we can't use it as the default.
   394→  const hasKeyboardOffset = vvTop > 0;
   395→  const contentStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
   396→    transition: 'width 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)',
   397→    ...(needsTasksPaneOffset
   398→      ? { width: `calc(100vw - ${effectiveTasksPaneWidth}px)` }
   399→      : needsFullscreenLayout
   400→      ? { width: '100vw' }
   401→      : {}),
   402→    ...(needsFullscreenLayout
   403→      ? hasKeyboardOffset
   404→        ? { top: vvTop, left: 0, height: vvHeight }
   405→        : { top: 0, left: 0, bottom: 0 }
   406→      : {}),
   407→  };
   408→
   409→  return (
   410→    <TooltipProvider delayDuration={500}>
   411→      <DialogPrimitive.Root
   412→        open={true}
   413→        modal={isActuallyModal}
   414→        disablePointerDismissal
   415→        onOpenChange={(_open, eventDetails) => {
   416→          // Prevent Base UI from updating internal state (which corrupts controlled open={true})
   417→          // and from calling stopPropagation on the native event (which blocks our custom handlers).
   418→          // Our own handlers in useLightboxNavigation (Escape) and handleOverlayClick (outside press)
   419→          // manage all closing logic.
   420→          eventDetails.cancel();
   421→          eventDetails.allowPropagation();
   422→        }}
   423→      >
   424→        <DialogPrimitive.Portal>
   425→          <DialogPrimitive.Backdrop
   426→            data-dialog-backdrop
   427→            className={cn(
   428→              "fixed z-[100000] bg-black/80 p-0 border-none shadow-none",
   429→              "data-[open]:animate-in data-[ending-style]:animate-out data-[ending-style]:fade-out-0 data-[open]:fade-in-0",
   430→              !isMobile && "duration-200"
   431→            )}
   432→            onPointerDown={handleOverlayPointerDown}
   433→            onPointerUp={handleOverlayPointerUp}
   434→            onClick={handleOverlayClick}
   435→            onTouchStart={handleTouchEvent}
   436→            onTouchMove={handleTouchEvent}
   437→            onTouchEnd={handleTouchEvent}
   438→            onTouchCancel={handleTouchCancel}
   439→            style={overlayStyle}
   440→          />
   441→
   442→          {/* Task pane handle removed - the existing PaneControlTab from TasksPane
   443→              is now visible above the lightbox at z-[100001] and handles all pane controls.
   444→              The overlay correctly accounts for the pane via shouldAccountForTasksPane. */}
   445→
   446→          <DialogPrimitive.Popup
   447→            ref={contentRef}
   448→            tabIndex={-1}
   449→            onPointerDownCapture={handleBgPointerDownCapture}
   450→            onClickCapture={handleBgClickCapture}
   451→            onPointerDown={handleContentPointerDown}
   452→            onClick={handleContentClick}
   453→            onTouchStart={handleTouchEvent}
   454→            onTouchMove={handleTouchEvent}
   455→            onTouchEnd={handleTouchEvent}
   456→            onTouchCancel={handleTouchCancel}
   457→            className={cn(
   458→              "fixed z-[100000]",
   459→              isMobile
   460→                ? ""
   461→                : "duration-200 data-[open]:animate-in data-[ending-style]:animate-out data-[ending-style]:fade-out-0 data-[open]:fade-in-0 data-[ending-style]:zoom-out-95 data-[open]:zoom-in-95",
   462→              "p-0 border-none bg-transparent shadow-none",
   463→              needsFullscreenLayout
   464→                ? "w-full"
   465→                : "left-[50%] top-[50%] translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%] w-auto h-auto data-[ending-style]:slide-out-to-left-1/2 data-[ending-style]:slide-out-to-top-[48%] data-[open]:slide-in-from-left-1/2 data-[open]:slide-in-from-top-[48%]"
   466→            )}
   467→            style={contentStyle}
   468→          >
   469→            {/* Accessibility: Hidden dialog title for screen readers */}
   470→            <DialogPrimitive.Title className="sr-only">
   471→              {accessibilityTitle}
   472→            </DialogPrimitive.Title>
   473→            <DialogPrimitive.Description className="sr-only">
   474→              {accessibilityDescription}
   475→            </DialogPrimitive.Description>
   476→
   477→            {children}
   478→          </DialogPrimitive.Popup>
   479→        </DialogPrimitive.Portal>
   480→      </DialogPrimitive.Root>
   481→    </TooltipProvider>
   482→  );
   483→};
```

```
     3→ *
     4→ * Replaces DesktopSidePanelLayout, MobileStackedLayout, and CenteredLayout.
     5→ * All conditional rendering derives from two values:
     6→ *   - showPanel: whether the controls panel renders
     7→ *   - shouldShowSidePanel: whether the panel goes right (side-by-side) or bottom (stacked)
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import React from 'react';
    11→import { cn } from '@/shared/lib/utils';
    12→import { Button } from '@/shared/components/ui/button';
    13→import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger } from '@/shared/components/ui/tooltip';
    14→import { Eraser, Square, Undo2, X, Diamond, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
    15→import type { LightboxLayoutProps } from './types';
    16→
    17→// Context hooks
    18→import {
    19→  useLightboxCoreSafe,
    20→  useLightboxMediaSafe,
    21→  useLightboxVariantsSafe,
    22→  useLightboxNavigationSafe,
    23→  useLightboxEditSafe,
    24→} from '../../contexts/LightboxStateContext';
    25→
    26→// Sub-components
    27→import { VariantOverlayBadge } from './VariantOverlayBadge';
    28→import { NewImageOverlayButton } from './NewImageOverlayButton';
    29→import { AdjacentSegmentNavigation } from './AdjacentSegmentNavigation';
    30→import { ConstituentImageNavigation } from './ConstituentImageNavigation';
    31→
    32→// Existing components
    33→import { NavigationArrows } from '../NavigationArrows';
    34→import { FloatingToolControls } from '../FloatingToolControls';
    35→import {
    36→  TopRightControls,
    37→  BottomLeftControls,
    38→  BottomRightControls,
    39→} from '../ButtonGroups';
    40→import { ControlsPanel } from '../ControlsPanel';
    41→import { MediaDisplayWithCanvas } from '../MediaDisplayWithCanvas';
    42→import { VideoEditModeDisplay } from '../VideoEditModeDisplay';
    43→import { VideoTrimModeDisplay } from '../VideoTrimModeDisplay';
    44→import { WorkflowControls } from '../WorkflowControls';
    45→import { WorkflowControlsBar } from '../WorkflowControlsBar';
    46→
    47→export const LightboxLayout: React.FC<LightboxLayoutProps> = (props) => {
    48→  // ========================================
    49→  // CONTEXT STATE
    50→  // ========================================
    51→  const core = useLightboxCoreSafe();
    52→  const mediaState = useLightboxMediaSafe();
    53→  const variantsState = useLightboxVariantsSafe();
    54→  const navigation = useLightboxNavigationSafe();
    55→  const editState = useLightboxEditSafe();
    56→
    57→  const { onClose, readOnly, isMobile, actualGenerationId, selectedProjectId } = core;
    58→  const { media, isVideo, effectiveMediaUrl, effectiveVideoUrl, imageDimensions, setImageDimensions, effectiveImageDimensions } = mediaState;
    59→  const { variants, activeVariant, primaryVariant, promoteSuccess, isPromoting, handlePromoteToGeneration, isMakingMainVariant, canMakeMainVariant, handleMakeMainVariant } = variantsState;
    60→  const { showNavigation, hasNext, hasPrevious, handleSlotNavNext, handleSlotNavPrev, swipeNavigation } = navigation;
    61→  const { isInpaintMode, isSpecialEditMode, editMode } = editState;
    62→
    63→  // ========================================
    64→  // PROPS
    65→  // ========================================
    66→  const {
    67→    showPanel,
    68→    shouldShowSidePanel,
    69→
    70→    // Video edit
    71→    isVideoTrimModeActive,
    72→    isVideoEditModeActive,
    73→    trimVideoRef,
    74→    trimState,
    75→    setVideoDuration,
    76→    setTrimCurrentTime,
    77→    videoEditing,
    78→
    79→    // Canvas/annotation
    80→    isAnnotateMode,
    81→    brushStrokes,
    82→    currentStroke,
    83→    isDrawing,
    84→    isEraseMode,
    85→    setIsEraseMode,
    86→    brushSize,
    87→    setBrushSize,
    88→    annotationMode,
    89→    selectedShapeId,
    90→    handleKonvaPointerDown,
    91→    handleKonvaPointerMove,
    92→    handleKonvaPointerUp,
    93→    handleShapeClick,
    94→    strokeOverlayRef,
    95→    handleUndo,
    96→    handleClearMask,
    97→    getDeleteButtonPosition,
    98→    handleToggleFreeForm,
    99→    handleDeleteSelected,
   100→    isRepositionDragging,
   101→    repositionDragHandlers,
   102→    getTransformStyle,
   103→    imageContainerRef,
   104→    canvasRef,
   105→    maskCanvasRef,
   106→    isFlippedHorizontally,
   107→    isSaving,
   108→
   109→    // Panel state
   110→    effectiveTasksPaneOpen,
   111→    effectiveTasksPaneWidth,
   112→
   113→    // Reposition rotation (for corner drag-to-rotate)
   114→    onRepositionRotationChange,
   115→    repositionRotation,
   116→
   117→    // Reposition scale (for +/- zoom buttons on image)
   118→    onRepositionScaleChange,
   119→    repositionScale,
   120→
   121→    // Composed prop objects
   122→    buttonGroupProps,
   123→    workflowBarProps,
   124→    floatingToolProps,
   125→    controlsPanelProps,
   126→
   127→    // Workflow controls (below media, centered only)
   128→    workflowControlsProps,
   129→
   130→    // Special navigation
   131→    adjacentSegments,
   132→    segmentSlotMode,
   133→  } = props;
   134→
   135→  // ========================================
   136→  // DERIVED LAYOUT VALUES
   137→  // ========================================
   138→  // shouldShowSidePanel = side-by-side (iPad landscape, desktop); !shouldShowSidePanel && showPanel = stacked (mobile/portrait)
   139→  const isSidePanelLayout = showPanel && shouldShowSidePanel;
   140→  const isStackedLayout = showPanel && !shouldShowSidePanel;
   141→
   142→  const enableSwipe = !showPanel || !shouldShowSidePanel;
   143→  const navArrowVariant = isSidePanelLayout ? 'desktop' : 'mobile';
   144→  const floatingToolVariant = isMobile ? 'mobile' : 'tablet';
   145→
   146→  // MediaDisplayWithCanvas variant/container
   147→  const mediaDisplayVariant = showPanel
   148→    ? (isSidePanelLayout ? 'desktop-side-panel' : 'mobile-stacked')
   149→    : 'regular-centered';
   150→  const mediaDisplayContainerClassName = isSidePanelLayout
   151→    ? 'max-w-full max-h-full'
   152→    : 'w-full h-full';
   153→  const mediaDisplayDebugContext = showPanel
   154→    ? (isSidePanelLayout ? 'Desktop' : 'Mobile Stacked')
   155→    : 'Regular Centered';
   156→
   157→  // Top center offset: stacked layout uses responsive top-4 md:top-16
   158→  const topCenterClassName = isStackedLayout
   159→    ? 'absolute top-4 md:top-16 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 z-[60] flex flex-col items-center gap-2'
   160→    : 'absolute top-4 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 z-[60] flex flex-col items-center gap-2';
   161→
   162→  // ========================================
   163→  // SHARED MEDIA CONTENT RENDERING
   164→  // ========================================
   165→  const renderMediaContent = () => {
   166→    if (isVideo && isVideoEditModeActive && videoEditing) {
   167→      return (
   168→        <VideoEditModeDisplay
   169→          videoRef={videoEditing.videoRef}
   170→          videoUrl={effectiveVideoUrl}
   171→          posterUrl={activeVariant?.thumbnail_url || media.thumbUrl}
   172→          videoDuration={trimState.videoDuration}
   173→          onLoadedMetadata={setVideoDuration}
   174→          selections={videoEditing.selections}
   175→          activeSelectionId={videoEditing.activeSelectionId}
   176→          onSelectionChange={videoEditing.handleUpdateSelection}
   177→          onSelectionClick={videoEditing.setActiveSelectionId}
   178→          onRemoveSelection={videoEditing.handleRemoveSelection}
   179→          onAddSelection={videoEditing.handleAddSelection}
   180→        />
   181→      );
   182→    }
   183→
   184→    if (isVideo && isVideoTrimModeActive) {
   185→      return (
   186→        <VideoTrimModeDisplay
   187→          videoRef={trimVideoRef}
   188→          videoUrl={effectiveVideoUrl}
   189→          posterUrl={activeVariant?.thumbnail_url || media.thumbUrl}
   190→          trimState={trimState}
   191→          onLoadedMetadata={setVideoDuration}
   192→          onTimeUpdate={setTrimCurrentTime}
   193→        />
   194→      );
   195→    }
   196→
   197→    // All layouts route through MediaDisplayWithCanvas (handles StyledVideoPlayer internally)
   198→    return (
   199→      <MediaDisplayWithCanvas
   200→        effectiveImageUrl={isVideo ? effectiveVideoUrl : effectiveMediaUrl}
   201→        thumbUrl={activeVariant?.thumbnail_url || media.thumbUrl}
   202→        isVideo={isVideo}
   203→        isFlippedHorizontally={isFlippedHorizontally}
   204→        isSaving={isSaving}
   205→        isInpaintMode={isInpaintMode}
   206→        editMode={editMode}
   207→        repositionTransformStyle={editMode === 'reposition' ? getTransformStyle() : undefined}
   208→        repositionDragHandlers={editMode === 'reposition' ? repositionDragHandlers : undefined}
   209→        isRepositionDragging={isRepositionDragging}
   210→        onRepositionRotationChange={editMode === 'reposition' ? onRepositionRotationChange : undefined}
   211→        repositionRotation={repositionRotation}
   212→        onRepositionScaleChange={editMode === 'reposition' ? onRepositionScaleChange : undefined}
   213→        repositionScale={repositionScale}
   214→        imageContainerRef={imageContainerRef}
   215→        canvasRef={canvasRef}
   216→        maskCanvasRef={maskCanvasRef}
   217→        onImageLoad={setImageDimensions}
   218→        onVideoLoadedMetadata={(e) => {
   219→          const video = e.currentTarget;
   220→          if (Number.isFinite(video.duration) && video.duration > 0) {
   221→            setVideoDuration(video.duration);
   222→          }
   223→        }}
   224→        variant={mediaDisplayVariant}
   225→        containerClassName={mediaDisplayContainerClassName}
   226→        tasksPaneWidth={isSidePanelLayout && effectiveTasksPaneOpen ? effectiveTasksPaneWidth : 0}
   227→        debugContext={mediaDisplayDebugContext}
   228→        // Konva-based stroke overlay props
   229→        imageDimensions={effectiveImageDimensions}
   230→        brushStrokes={brushStrokes}
   231→        currentStroke={currentStroke}
   232→        isDrawing={isDrawing}
   233→        isEraseMode={isEraseMode}
   234→        brushSize={brushSize}
   235→        annotationMode={editMode === 'annotate' ? annotationMode : null}
   236→        selectedShapeId={selectedShapeId}
   237→        onStrokePointerDown={handleKonvaPointerDown}
   238→        onStrokePointerMove={handleKonvaPointerMove}
   239→        onStrokePointerUp={handleKonvaPointerUp}
   240→        onShapeClick={handleShapeClick}
   241→        strokeOverlayRef={strokeOverlayRef}
   242→      />
   243→    );
   244→  };
   245→
   246→  // ========================================
   247→  // SHARED ANNOTATION BUTTONS
   248→  // ========================================
   249→  const renderAnnotationButtons = () => {
   250→    if (!selectedShapeId || !isAnnotateMode) return null;
   251→
   252→    const buttonPos = getDeleteButtonPosition();
   253→    if (!buttonPos) return null;
   254→
   255→    const selectedShape = brushStrokes.find(s => s.id === selectedShapeId);
   256→    const isFreeForm = selectedShape?.isFreeForm || false;
   257→
   258→    return (
   259→      <div className="fixed z-[100] flex gap-2" style={{
   260→        left: `${buttonPos.x}px`,
   261→        top: `${buttonPos.y}px`,
   262→        transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)'
   263→      }}>
   264→        <button
   265→          onClick={handleToggleFreeForm}
   266→          className={cn(
   267→            "rounded-full p-2 shadow-lg transition-colors",
   268→            isFreeForm
   269→              ? "bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white"
   270→              : "bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 text-white"
   271→          )}
   272→          title={isFreeForm
   273→            ? "Switch to rectangle mode (edges move linearly)"
   274→            : "Switch to free-form mode (rhombus/non-orthogonal angles)"}
   275→        >
   276→          {isFreeForm ? <Diamond className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Square className="h-4 w-4" />}
   277→        </button>
   278→        <button
   279→          onClick={handleDeleteSelected}
   280→          className="bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white rounded-full p-2 shadow-lg transition-colors"
   281→          title="Delete annotation (or press DELETE key)"
   282→        >
   283→          <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
   284→        </button>
   285→      </div>
   286→    );
   287→  };
   288→
   289→  // ========================================
   290→  // RENDER
   291→  // ========================================
   292→
   293→  if (showPanel) {
   294→    // ======== PANEL LAYOUT (Desktop side panel / Mobile stacked) ========
   295→    const isDesktopPanel = isSidePanelLayout;
   296→
   297→    return (
   298→      <div
   299→        data-lightbox-bg
   300→        className={cn(
   301→          "w-full h-full bg-black/90",
   302→          isDesktopPanel ? "flex" : "flex flex-col"
   303→        )}
   304→        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
   305→      >
   306→        {/* Media section */}
   307→        <div
   308→          data-lightbox-bg
   309→          className={cn(
   310→            "flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden",
   311→            isDesktopPanel
   312→              ? "flex-1 touch-none"
   313→              : "flex-none touch-pan-y z-10"
   314→          )}
   315→          style={isDesktopPanel
   316→            ? { width: '60%' }
   317→            : {
   318→                height: '50%',
   319→                transform: swipeNavigation.isSwiping ? `translateX(${swipeNavigation.swipeOffset}px)` : undefined,
   320→                transition: swipeNavigation.isSwiping ? 'none' : 'transform 0.2s ease-out',
   321→              }
   322→          }
   323→          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
   324→          {...(!isDesktopPanel ? swipeNavigation.swipeHandlers : {})}
   325→        >
   326→          {/* Desktop: nav arrows before media */}
   327→          {isDesktopPanel && (
   328→            <NavigationArrows
   329→              showNavigation={showNavigation}
   330→              readOnly={readOnly}
   331→              onPrevious={handleSlotNavPrev}
   332→              onNext={handleSlotNavNext}
   333→              hasPrevious={hasPrevious}
   334→              hasNext={hasNext}
   335→              variant="desktop"
   336→            />
   337→          )}
   338→
   339→          {renderMediaContent()}
   340→          {renderAnnotationButtons()}
   341→
   342→          {/* Top Center - segment nav + variant badge */}
   343→          <div className={topCenterClassName}>
   344→            {adjacentSegments && !isVideo && (
   345→              <AdjacentSegmentNavigation adjacentSegments={adjacentSegments} />
   346→            )}
   347→            <VariantOverlayBadge
   348→              activeVariant={activeVariant}
   349→              variants={variants}
   350→              readOnly={readOnly}
   351→              isMakingMainVariant={isMakingMainVariant}
   352→              canMakeMainVariant={canMakeMainVariant}
   353→              onMakeMainVariant={handleMakeMainVariant}
   354→            />
   355→          </div>
   356→
   357→          {/* Top Left - New image button */}
   358→          <NewImageOverlayButton
   359→            isVideo={isVideo}
   360→            readOnly={readOnly}
   361→            activeVariantId={activeVariant?.id}
   362→            primaryVariantId={primaryVariant?.id}
   363→            selectedProjectId={selectedProjectId}
   364→            isPromoting={isPromoting}
   365→            promoteSuccess={promoteSuccess}
   366→            onPromote={handlePromoteToGeneration}
   367→          />
   368→
   369→          {/* Floating Tool Controls (panel layouts only) */}
   370→          {isSpecialEditMode && floatingToolProps && (
   371→            <FloatingToolControls
   372→              variant={floatingToolVariant}
   373→              repositionTransform={floatingToolProps.repositionTransform}
   374→              onRepositionScaleChange={floatingToolProps.onRepositionScaleChange}
   375→              onRepositionRotationChange={floatingToolProps.onRepositionRotationChange}
   376→              onRepositionFlipH={floatingToolProps.onRepositionFlipH}
   377→              onRepositionFlipV={floatingToolProps.onRepositionFlipV}
   378→              onRepositionReset={floatingToolProps.onRepositionReset}
   379→            />
   380→          )}
   381→
   382→          {/* Button Groups */}
   383→          <BottomLeftControls {...buttonGroupProps.bottomLeft} />
   384→          <BottomRightControls {...buttonGroupProps.bottomRight} />
   385→          <TopRightControls {...buttonGroupProps.topRight} />
   386→
   387→          {/* Constituent Image Navigation */}
   388→          {segmentSlotMode?.onNavigateToImage && (
   389→            <ConstituentImageNavigation
   390→              startImageId={segmentSlotMode.pairData.startImage?.id}
   391→              endImageId={segmentSlotMode.pairData.endImage?.id}
   392→              startImageUrl={segmentSlotMode.pairData.startImage?.thumbUrl || segmentSlotMode.pairData.startImage?.url}
   393→              endImageUrl={segmentSlotMode.pairData.endImage?.thumbUrl || segmentSlotMode.pairData.endImage?.url}
   394→              onNavigateToImage={segmentSlotMode.onNavigateToImage}
   395→              variant="overlay"
   396→            />
   397→          )}
   398→
   399→          {/* Bottom Workflow Controls Bar */}
   400→          <WorkflowControlsBar
   401→            onAddToShot={workflowBarProps.onAddToShot}
   402→            onDelete={workflowBarProps.onDelete}
   403→            onApplySettings={workflowBarProps.onApplySettings}
   404→            isSpecialEditMode={isSpecialEditMode}
   405→            isVideo={isVideo}
   406→            mediaId={actualGenerationId}
   407→            imageUrl={effectiveMediaUrl}
   408→            thumbUrl={media.thumbUrl}
   409→            allShots={workflowBarProps.allShots}
   410→            selectedShotId={workflowBarProps.selectedShotId}
   411→            onShotChange={workflowBarProps.onShotChange}
   412→            onCreateShot={workflowBarProps.onCreateShot}
   413→            isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot={workflowBarProps.isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot}
   414→            isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition={workflowBarProps.isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition}
   415→            showTickForImageId={workflowBarProps.showTickForImageId}
   416→            showTickForSecondaryImageId={workflowBarProps.showTickForSecondaryImageId}
   417→            onAddToShotWithoutPosition={workflowBarProps.onAddToShotWithoutPosition}
   418→            onShowTick={workflowBarProps.onShowTick}
   419→            onShowSecondaryTick={workflowBarProps.onShowSecondaryTick}
   420→            onOptimisticPositioned={workflowBarProps.onOptimisticPositioned}
   421→            onOptimisticUnpositioned={workflowBarProps.onOptimisticUnpositioned}
   422→            contentRef={workflowBarProps.contentRef}
   423→            handleApplySettings={workflowBarProps.handleApplySettings}
   424→            onNavigateToShot={workflowBarProps.handleNavigateToShotFromSelector}
   425→            onClose={onClose}
   426→            onAddVariantAsNewGeneration={workflowBarProps.handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot}
   427→            activeVariantId={activeVariant?.id || primaryVariant?.id}
   428→            currentTimelineFrame={media.timeline_frame}
   429→          />
   430→
   431→          {/* Stacked: nav arrows after media */}
   432→          {!isDesktopPanel && (
   433→            <NavigationArrows
   434→              showNavigation={showNavigation}
   435→              readOnly={readOnly}
   436→              onPrevious={handleSlotNavPrev}
   437→              onNext={handleSlotNavNext}
   438→              hasPrevious={hasPrevious}
   439→              hasNext={hasNext}
   440→              variant="mobile"
   441→            />
   442→          )}
   443→        </div>
   444→
   445→        {/* Controls Panel */}
   446→        <div
   447→          data-task-details-panel
   448→          className={cn(
   449→            "bg-background overflow-hidden relative z-[60] overscroll-contain",
   450→            isDesktopPanel
   451→              ? "border-l border-border h-full"
   452→              : "border-t border-border overflow-y-auto"
   453→          )}
   454→          style={isDesktopPanel ? { width: '40%' } : { height: '50%' }}
   455→        >
   456→          <ControlsPanel
   457→            variant={isDesktopPanel ? 'desktop' : 'mobile'}
   458→            {...controlsPanelProps!}
   459→          />
   460→        </div>
   461→      </div>
   462→    );
   463→  }
   464→
   465→  // ======== CENTERED LAYOUT (no panel) ========
   466→  return (
   467→    <div
   468→      data-lightbox-bg
   469→      className="relative flex flex-col items-center gap-3 sm:gap-4 md:gap-6 px-3 py-4 sm:px-4 sm:py-6 md:px-6 md:py-8 w-full h-full"
   470→      onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
   471→    >
   472→      {/* Media Container with swipe navigation */}
   473→      <div
   474→        data-lightbox-bg
   475→        className={cn(
   476→          "relative flex items-center justify-center max-w-full my-auto",
   477→          isMobile && isInpaintMode && "pointer-events-auto",
   478→          "touch-pan-y"
   479→        )}
   480→        style={{
   481→          height: 'calc(100vh - 220px)',
   482→          maxHeight: 'calc(100vh - 220px)',
   483→          transform: swipeNavigation.isSwiping ? `translateX(${swipeNavigation.swipeOffset}px)` : undefined,
   484→          transition: swipeNavigation.isSwiping ? 'none' : 'transform 0.2s ease-out',
   485→        }}
   486→        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
   487→        {...swipeNavigation.swipeHandlers}
   488→      >
   489→        {renderMediaContent()}
   490→        {renderAnnotationButtons()}
   491→
   492→        {/* Top Center - segment nav + variant badge */}
   493→        <div className="absolute top-4 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 z-[60] flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
   494→          {adjacentSegments && !isVideo && (
   495→            <AdjacentSegmentNavigation adjacentSegments={adjacentSegments} />
   496→          )}
   497→          <VariantOverlayBadge
   498→            activeVariant={activeVariant}
   499→            variants={variants}
   500→            readOnly={readOnly}
   501→            isMakingMainVariant={isMakingMainVariant}
   502→            canMakeMainVariant={canMakeMainVariant}
   503→            onMakeMainVariant={handleMakeMainVariant}
   504→          />
   505→        </div>
   506→
   507→        {/* Top Left - New image button */}
   508→        <NewImageOverlayButton
   509→          isVideo={isVideo}
   510→          readOnly={readOnly}
   511→          activeVariantId={activeVariant?.id}
   512→          primaryVariantId={primaryVariant?.id}
   513→          selectedProjectId={selectedProjectId}
   514→          isPromoting={isPromoting}
   515→          promoteSuccess={promoteSuccess}
   516→          onPromote={handlePromoteToGeneration}
   517→        />
   518→
   519→        {/* Compact Edit Controls (centered layout only, no panel to hold them) */}
   520→        {!readOnly && isSpecialEditMode && editMode !== 'text' && (
   521→          <div
   522→            className="absolute top-20 left-4 z-[70] select-none"
   523→            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
   524→          >
   525→            <div className="mb-2 bg-background backdrop-blur-md rounded-lg p-2 space-y-1.5 w-40 border border-border shadow-xl">
   526→              {/* Brush Size Slider - Only in Inpaint mode */}
   527→              {editMode === 'inpaint' && (
   528→                <div className="space-y-0.5">
   529→                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
   530→                    <label className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">Size:</label>
   531→                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{brushSize}px</span>
   532→                  </div>
   533→                  <input
   534→                    type="range"
   535→                    min={5}
   536→                    max={100}
   537→                    value={brushSize}
   538→                    onChange={(e) => setBrushSize!(parseInt(e.target.value))}
   539→                    className="w-full h-1.5 bg-muted rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-blue-500"
   540→                  />
   541→                </div>
   542→              )}
   543→
   544→              {/* Paint/Erase Toggle */}
   545→              {editMode === 'inpaint' && (
   546→                <Button
   547→                  variant={isEraseMode ? "default" : "secondary"}
   548→                  size="sm"
   549→                  onClick={() => setIsEraseMode!(!isEraseMode)}
   550→                  className={cn(
   551→                    "w-full text-xs h-7",
   552→                    isEraseMode && "bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700"
   553→                  )}
   554→                >
   555→                  <Eraser className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
   556→                  {isEraseMode ? 'Erase' : 'Paint'}
   557→                </Button>
   558→              )}
   559→
   560→              {editMode === 'annotate' && (
   561→                <div className="flex gap-1">
   562→                  <Button
   563→                    variant="default"
   564→                    size="sm"
   565→                    className="flex-1 text-xs h-7"
   566→                    disabled
   567→                  >
   568→                    <Square className="h-3 w-3" />
   569→                  </Button>
   570→                </div>
   571→              )}
   572→
   573→              {/* Undo | Clear */}
```

     3→/**
     4→ * useSwipeNavigation - Horizontal swipe gesture for lightbox navigation
     5→ * 
     6→ * Provides touch/pointer-based swipe navigation for mobile and iPad devices.
     7→ * Features:
     8→ * - Horizontal swipe detection with threshold and velocity
     9→ * - Visual offset feedback during swipe
    10→ * - Automatic detection of interactive elements to avoid conflicts
    11→ * - Vertical scroll detection to avoid interfering with scrollable areas
    12→ * - Elastic resistance when no next/previous available
    13→ * 
    14→ * @example
    15→ * ```tsx
    16→ * const swipe = useSwipeNavigation({
    17→ *   onSwipeLeft: () => goNext(),
    18→ *   onSwipeRight: () => goPrevious(),
    19→ *   disabled: isEditMode,
    20→ *   hasNext: true,
    21→ *   hasPrevious: true,
    22→ * });
    23→ * 
    24→ * <div {...swipe.swipeHandlers} style={{ transform: `translateX(${swipe.swipeOffset}px)` }}>

    27→ * ```

    30→export interface UseSwipeNavigationProps {
    31→  /** Called when user swipes left (navigate to next) */

    39→  /** Minimum velocity (px/ms) for quick flick gestures (default: 0.3) */

    48→
    49→export interface UseSwipeNavigationReturn {
    50→  /** Handlers to spread on the swipeable element */

    52→    onPointerDown: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
    53→    onPointerMove: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
    54→    onPointerUp: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;

    66→  startTime: number;

    73→/**
    74→ * Check if an element or its ancestors should block swipe gestures
    75→ */
    76→function isInteractiveElement(el: HTMLElement | null): boolean {
    77→  const interactiveTags = ['BUTTON', 'INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT', 'A', 'VIDEO', 'CANVAS'];
    78→  const interactiveRoles = ['button', 'slider', 'textbox', 'link', 'scrollbar'];
    79→  
    80→  let current: HTMLElement | null = el;
    81→  while (current) {
    82→    // Check tag name
    83→    if (interactiveTags.includes(current.tagName)) {
    84→      return true;
    85→    }
    86→    
    87→    // Check role attribute
    88→    const role = current.getAttribute('role');
    89→    if (role && interactiveRoles.includes(role)) {
    90→      return true;
    91→    }
    92→    
    93→    // Check for explicit no-swipe marker
    94→    if (current.getAttribute('data-no-swipe') === 'true') {
    95→      return true;
    96→    }
    97→    
    98→    // Check for scrollable containers
    99→    if (current.getAttribute('data-scrollable') === 'true') {
   100→      return true;
   101→    }
   102→    
   103→    // Check if element has overflow scroll
   104→    const style = window.getComputedStyle(current);
   105→    if (
   106→      (style.overflowY === 'scroll' || style.overflowY === 'auto') &&
   107→      current.scrollHeight > current.clientHeight
   108→    ) {
   109→      return true;
   110→    }
   111→    
   112→    // Check for canvas (drawing surfaces)
   113→    if (current.tagName === 'CANVAS') {
   114→      return true;
   115→    }
   116→    
   117→    // Check for scroll area viewports that should block swipe
   118→    if (current.getAttribute('data-scroll-area-viewport')) {
   119→      return true;
   120→    }
   121→    
   122→    current = current.parentElement;
   123→  }
   124→  
   125→  return false;
   126→}
   127→
   128→export function useSwipeNavigation({
   129→  onSwipeLeft,
   130→  onSwipeRight,
   131→  disabled = false,
   132→  threshold = 50,
   133→  velocityThreshold = 0.3,
   134→  hasNext = true,
   135→  hasPrevious = true,
   136→  maxElasticOffset = 80,
   137→}: UseSwipeNavigationProps): UseSwipeNavigationReturn {
   138→  const [swipeOffset, setSwipeOffset] = useState(0);
   139→  const [isSwiping, setIsSwiping] = useState(false);
   140→  const swipeStateRef = useRef<SwipeState | null>(null);
   141→  
   142→  // Apply elastic resistance at edges
   143→  const applyElasticResistance = useCallback((deltaX: number): number => {
   144→    // Swiping right (showing previous) but no previous
   145→    if (deltaX > 0 && !hasPrevious) {
   146→      // Apply strong resistance - logarithmic falloff
   147→      return Math.sign(deltaX) * Math.min(maxElasticOffset, Math.abs(deltaX) * 0.3);
   148→    }
   149→    
   150→    // Swiping left (showing next) but no next
   151→    if (deltaX < 0 && !hasNext) {
   152→      return Math.sign(deltaX) * Math.min(maxElasticOffset, Math.abs(deltaX) * 0.3);
   153→    }
   154→    
   155→    // Normal case - apply mild resistance for visual feedback
   156→    // Cap at a reasonable distance to indicate swipe direction
   157→    const maxNormalOffset = 150;
   158→    if (Math.abs(deltaX) > maxNormalOffset) {
   159→      const excess = Math.abs(deltaX) - maxNormalOffset;
   160→      return Math.sign(deltaX) * (maxNormalOffset + excess * 0.2);
   161→    }
   162→    
   163→    return deltaX;
   164→  }, [hasNext, hasPrevious, maxElasticOffset]);
   165→  
   166→  const handlePointerDown = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent) => {
   167→    if (disabled) return;
   168→
   169→    // Only handle primary pointer (first finger/mouse button)
   170→    if (!e.isPrimary) return;
   171→
   172→    // Check if we should skip swipe for this target
   173→    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
   174→    if (isInteractiveElement(target)) {
   175→      return;
   176→    }
   177→    
   178→    swipeStateRef.current = {
   179→      startX: e.clientX,
   180→      startY: e.clientY,
   181→      startTime: Date.now(),
   182→      currentX: e.clientX,
   183→      pointerId: e.pointerId,
   184→      isLocked: false,

   189→    try {

   193→      console.log('[SwipeNav] Could not capture pointer:', err);

   195→  }, [disabled]);

   198→    const state = swipeStateRef.current;
   199→    if (!state || !e.isPrimary || state.pointerId !== e.pointerId) return;
   200→    
   201→    const deltaX = e.clientX - state.startX;
   202→    const deltaY = e.clientY - state.startY;
   203→    const absDeltaX = Math.abs(deltaX);
   204→    const absDeltaY = Math.abs(deltaY);
   205→    
   206→    // If direction not determined yet, check once we have enough movement
   207→    if (!state.isLocked && (absDeltaX > 10 || absDeltaY > 10)) {

   209→      // Use a ratio to decide - if vertical movement is dominant, it's a scroll
   210→      state.isHorizontal = absDeltaX > absDeltaY * 0.8;
   211→      state.isLocked = true;
   212→      
   213→      console.log('[SwipeNav] Direction locked:', {
   214→        isHorizontal: state.isHorizontal,
   215→        deltaX,
   216→        deltaY,
   217→        ratio: absDeltaX / Math.max(absDeltaY, 1),

   221→      if (!state.isHorizontal) {

   233→    if (state.isLocked && state.isHorizontal) {

   235→      e.preventDefault();
   236→      
   237→      state.currentX = e.clientX;
   238→

   249→    
   250→    const deltaX = e.clientX - state.startX;
   251→    const duration = Math.max(Date.now() - state.startTime, 1);
   252→    const velocity = Math.abs(deltaX) / duration;
   253→    const absDeltaX = Math.abs(deltaX);

   262→    });

```
1→import { useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→
     3→export interface UseLightboxNavigationProps {
     4→  onNext?: () => void;
     5→  onPrevious?: () => void;
     6→  onClose: () => void;
     7→}
     8→
     9→export interface UseLightboxNavigationReturn {
    10→  safeClose: () => void;
    11→  activateClickShield: () => void;
    12→}
    13→
    14→/**
    15→ * Hook for managing lightbox navigation
    16→ * Handles keyboard controls (arrow keys, escape) and safe closing with click shield
    17→ */
    18→export const useLightboxNavigation = ({
    19→  onNext,
    20→  onPrevious,
    21→  onClose,
    22→}: UseLightboxNavigationProps): UseLightboxNavigationReturn => {
    23→  
    24→  // Short-lived global click shield to absorb iOS synthetic clicks after touchend
    25→  const activateClickShield = useCallback(() => {
    26→    try {
    27→      const shield = document.createElement('div');
    28→      shield.setAttribute('data-mobile-click-shield', 'true');
    29→      shield.style.position = 'fixed';
    30→      shield.style.top = '0';
    31→      shield.style.left = '0';
    32→      shield.style.right = '0';
    33→      shield.style.bottom = '0';
    34→      shield.style.background = 'transparent';
    35→      shield.style.pointerEvents = 'all';
    36→      shield.style.zIndex = '2147483647';
    37→      shield.style.touchAction = 'none';
    38→
    39→      const block = (ev: Event) => {
    40→        try { ev.preventDefault(); } catch {}
    41→        try { ev.stopPropagation(); } catch {}
    42→        try { ev.stopImmediatePropagation?.(); } catch {}
    43→      };
    44→
    45→      shield.addEventListener('click', block, true);
    46→      shield.addEventListener('pointerdown', block, true);
    47→      shield.addEventListener('pointerup', block, true);
    48→      shield.addEventListener('touchstart', block, { capture: true, passive: false } as AddEventListenerOptions);
    49→      shield.addEventListener('touchend', block, { capture: true, passive: false } as AddEventListenerOptions);
    50→
    51→      document.body.appendChild(shield);
    52→
    53→      window.setTimeout(() => {
    54→        try { shield.remove(); } catch {}
    55→      }, 350);
    56→    } catch {}
    57→  }, []);
    58→
    59→  const safeClose = useCallback(() => {
    60→    activateClickShield();
    61→    onClose();
    62→  }, [activateClickShield, onClose]);
    63→
    64→  /**
    65→   * Global key handler
    66→   * --------------------------------------------------
    67→   * We register a document-level keydown listener so that
    68→   * arrow navigation still works even when an embedded
    69→   * <video> element (which is focusable) steals keyboard
    70→   * focus.
    71→   * 
    72→   * IMPORTANT: Don't handle keys if another dialog is open on top
    73→   */
    74→  useEffect(() => {
    75→    const handleWindowKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    76→      // Check if another dialog/modal is open on top by looking for higher z-index dialog overlays
    77→      const dialogOverlays = document.querySelectorAll('[data-dialog-backdrop]');
    78→      const hasHigherZIndexDialog = Array.from(dialogOverlays).some((overlay) => {
    79→        const zIndex = parseInt(window.getComputedStyle(overlay as Element).zIndex || '0', 10);
    80→        // MediaLightbox uses z-[100000], check if any higher z-index dialogs are open
    81→        return zIndex > 100000;
    82→      });
    83→
    84→      // Don't handle keys if a higher z-index dialog is open
    85→      if (hasHigherZIndexDialog) {
    86→        return;
    87→      }
    88→
    89→      // Check if user is currently typing in a text input field
    90→      const activeElement = document.activeElement;
    91→      const isTyping = activeElement && (
    92→        activeElement.tagName === 'INPUT' ||
    93→        activeElement.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ||
    94→        (activeElement as HTMLElement).contentEditable === 'true' ||
    95→        (activeElement as HTMLElement).isContentEditable
    96→      );
    97→
```

```
    38→  handleKonvaPointerDown: (point: { x: number; y: number }, e: KonvaEventObject<PointerEvent>) => void;
    39→  handleKonvaPointerMove: (point: { x: number; y: number }, e: KonvaEventObject<PointerEvent>) => void;
    40→  handleKonvaPointerUp: (e: KonvaEventObject<PointerEvent>) => void;
    41→  handleShapeClick: (strokeId: string, point: { x: number; y: number }) => void;
```
