```
    44→export function usePointerHandlers({
    45→  isInpaintMode,
    46→  editMode,
    47→  annotationMode,
    48→  isAnnotateMode,
    49→  brushStrokes,
    50→  annotationStrokes,
    51→  isEraseMode,
    52→  brushSize,
    53→  setBrushStrokes,
    54→  setAnnotationStrokes,
    55→  setShowTextModeHint,
    56→}: UsePointerHandlersProps): UsePointerHandlersReturn {
    57→  // Drawing state
    58→  const [isDrawing, setIsDrawing] = useState(false);
    59→  const [currentStroke, setCurrentStroke] = useState<Array<{ x: number; y: number }>>([]);
    60→  const [selectedShapeId, setSelectedShapeId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    61→
    62→  // Drag state (encapsulated in useDragState hook)
    63→  const {
    64→    isDragging: isDraggingShape,
    65→    dragOffset,
    66→    dragMode,
    67→    draggingCornerIndex,
    68→    draggedShapeRef,
    69→    startMoveDrag,
    70→    startResizeDrag,
    71→    startCornerDrag,
    72→    endDrag,
    73→    updateDraggedShape,
    74→  } = useDragState();
    75→
    76→  // Refs for tracking
    77→  const lastClickTimeRef = useRef<number>(0);
    78→  const lastClickPositionRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
    79→  const dragStartPosRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
    80→  const hintTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
    81→  const hasInitializedCanvasRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
    82→  const lastDrawnPointRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
    83→
    84→  // Cleanup hint timeout on unmount
    85→  useEffect(() => {
    86→    return () => {
    87→      if (hintTimeoutRef.current) {
    88→        clearTimeout(hintTimeoutRef.current);
    89→        hintTimeoutRef.current = null;
    90→      }
    91→    };
    92→  }, []);
    93→
    94→  /**
    95→   * Handle pointer down - start drawing or select/drag shape
    96→   */
    97→  const handleKonvaPointerDown = useCallback((point: { x: number; y: number }, e: KonvaEventObject<PointerEvent>) => {
    98→    const { x, y } = point;
    99→
   100→    // Allow both inpaint mode and annotate mode
   101→    if (!isInpaintMode && !isAnnotateMode) return;
   102→
   103→    // Prevent drawing in text edit mode
   104→    if (editMode === 'text') {
   105→      setShowTextModeHint(true);
   106→      if (hintTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(hintTimeoutRef.current);
   107→      hintTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
   108→        setShowTextModeHint(false);
   109→        hintTimeoutRef.current = null;
   110→      }, 2000);
   111→      return;
   112→    }
   113→
   114→    // Store drag start position for tap detection
   115→    dragStartPosRef.current = { x, y };
   116→
   117→    // In annotate mode, check if clicking on existing shape
   118→    if (isAnnotateMode && annotationMode === 'rectangle') {
   119→      for (let i = brushStrokes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   120→        const stroke = brushStrokes[i];
   121→        if (stroke.shapeType === 'rectangle' && isPointOnShape(x, y, stroke)) {
   122→          console.log('[Annotate] Clicked on rectangle:', stroke.id);
   123→          setSelectedShapeId(stroke.id);
   124→
   125→          // Check for corner click (for free-form dragging)
   126→          const now = Date.now();
   127→          const cornerIndex = getClickedCornerIndex(x, y, stroke);
   128→          const lastClickPos = lastClickPositionRef.current;
   129→          const isDoubleClick = cornerIndex !== null &&
   130→            now - lastClickTimeRef.current < 300 &&
   131→            lastClickPos &&
   132→            Math.hypot(x - lastClickPos.x, y - lastClickPos.y) < 10;
   133→
   134→          lastClickTimeRef.current = now;
   135→          lastClickPositionRef.current = { x, y };
   136→
   137→          // Free-form corner dragging
   138→          if (stroke.isFreeForm && cornerIndex !== null) {
   139→            startCornerDrag(stroke, cornerIndex);
   140→            return;
   141→          }
   142→
   143→          // Double-click to enable free-form mode
   144→          if (isDoubleClick && cornerIndex !== null && !stroke.isFreeForm) {
   145→            const corners = getRectangleCorners(stroke);
   146→            const updatedStroke: BrushStroke = {
   147→              ...stroke,
   148→              points: corners,
   149→              isFreeForm: true
   150→            };
   151→            const newStrokes = brushStrokes.map(s => s.id === stroke.id ? updatedStroke : s);
   152→            setBrushStrokes(newStrokes);
   153→            startCornerDrag(updatedStroke, cornerIndex);
   154→            return;
   155→          }
   156→
   157→          // Determine if clicking edge (move) or corner (resize)
   158→          const clickType = getRectangleClickType(x, y, stroke);
   159→
   160→          if (clickType === 'edge') {
   161→            startMoveDrag(stroke, x, y);
   162→            return;
   163→          } else if (clickType === 'corner' && !stroke.isFreeForm) {
   164→            startResizeDrag(stroke, x, y);
   165→            return;
   166→          }
   167→
   168→          return; // Clicked in middle, just keep selected
   169→        }
   170→      }
   171→
   172→      // Clicked on empty space, deselect
   173→      if (selectedShapeId) {
   174→        setSelectedShapeId(null);
   175→      }
   176→    }
   177→
   178→    // Start new stroke
   179→    console.log('[Inpaint] Starting new stroke (Konva)', { x, y, isAnnotateMode, annotationMode });
   180→    setIsDrawing(true);
   181→    hasInitializedCanvasRef.current = false;
   182→    lastDrawnPointRef.current = null;
   183→    setCurrentStroke([{ x, y }]);
   184→  }, [isInpaintMode, isAnnotateMode, annotationMode, brushStrokes, selectedShapeId, editMode, setBrushStrokes, setShowTextModeHint, startCornerDrag, startMoveDrag, startResizeDrag]);
   185→
   186→  /**
   187→   * Handle pointer move - continue drawing or dragging
   188→   */
   189→  const handleKonvaPointerMove = useCallback((point: { x: number; y: number }, e: KonvaEventObject<PointerEvent>) => {
   190→    // Allow both inpaint mode and annotate mode
   191→    if (!isInpaintMode && !isAnnotateMode) return;
   192→    if (editMode === 'text' && !isDraggingShape) return;
   193→
   194→    // Check if the pointer button was released outside the canvas and user returned
   195→    if ((isDrawing || isDraggingShape) && e.evt.buttons === 0) {
   196→      console.log('[Inpaint] Pointer returned with no button pressed - canceling');
   197→      if (isDrawing) {
   198→        setIsDrawing(false);
   199→        hasInitializedCanvasRef.current = false;
   200→        lastDrawnPointRef.current = null;
   201→        setCurrentStroke([]);
   202→      }
   203→      if (isDraggingShape) {
   204→        endDrag();
   205→      }
   206→      return;
   207→    }
   208→
   209→    const { x, y } = point;
   210→
   211→    // Handle dragging selected shape
   212→    if (isDraggingShape && draggedShapeRef.current) {
   213→      const shape = draggedShapeRef.current;
   214→
   215→      // Free-form corner dragging
   216→      if (draggingCornerIndex !== null && shape.isFreeForm && shape.points.length === 4) {
   217→        const newPoints = [...shape.points];
   218→        newPoints[draggingCornerIndex] = { x, y };
   219→
   220→        const updatedShape: BrushStroke = {
   221→          ...shape,
   222→          points: newPoints,
   223→          isFreeForm: true
   224→        };
   225→
   226→        const newStrokes = brushStrokes.map(s => s.id === shape.id ? updatedShape : s);
   227→        setBrushStrokes(newStrokes);
   228→        updateDraggedShape(updatedShape);
   229→        return;
   230→      }
   231→
   232→      // Move mode
   233→      if (dragMode === 'move' && dragOffset) {
   234→        const newStartX = x - dragOffset.x;
   235→        const newStartY = y - dragOffset.y;
   236→        const oldStartPoint = shape.points[0];
   237→        const deltaX = newStartX - oldStartPoint.x;
   238→        const deltaY = newStartY - oldStartPoint.y;
   239→
   240→        const updatedPoints = shape.points.map(p => ({
   241→          x: p.x + deltaX,
   242→          y: p.y + deltaY
   243→        }));
   244→
   245→        const updatedShape: BrushStroke = {
   246→          ...shape,
   247→          points: updatedPoints,
   248→          isFreeForm: shape.isFreeForm
   249→        };
   250→
   251→        const newStrokes = brushStrokes.map(s => s.id === shape.id ? updatedShape : s);
   252→        setBrushStrokes(newStrokes);
   253→        updateDraggedShape(updatedShape);
   254→        return;
   255→      }
   256→
   257→      // Resize mode
   258→      if (dragMode === 'resize' && !shape.isFreeForm) {
   259→        const endPoint = shape.points[1];
   260→        const updatedShape: BrushStroke = {
   261→          ...shape,
   262→          points: [{ x, y }, endPoint]
   263→        };
   264→
   265→        const newStrokes = brushStrokes.map(s => s.id === shape.id ? updatedShape : s);
   266→        setBrushStrokes(newStrokes);
   267→        updateDraggedShape(updatedShape);
   268→        return;
   269→      }
   270→    }
   271→
   272→    // Continue drawing stroke
   273→    if (!isDrawing) return;
   274→
   275→    setCurrentStroke(prev => [...prev, { x, y }]);
   276→  }, [isInpaintMode, isAnnotateMode, editMode, isDrawing, isDraggingShape, dragMode, dragOffset, draggingCornerIndex, brushStrokes, setBrushStrokes, endDrag, updateDraggedShape]);
   277→
   278→  /**
   279→   * Handle pointer up - finish drawing or dragging
   280→   */
   281→  const handleKonvaPointerUp = useCallback((e: KonvaEventObject<PointerEvent>) => {
   282→    // Handle finishing drag operation
   283→    if (isDraggingShape) {
   284→      endDrag();
   285→      return;
   286→    }
   287→
   288→    // Allow both inpaint mode and annotate mode
   289→    if ((!isInpaintMode && !isAnnotateMode) || !isDrawing) return;
   290→    if (editMode === 'text') return;
   291→
   292→    setIsDrawing(false);
   293→    hasInitializedCanvasRef.current = false;
   294→    lastDrawnPointRef.current = null;
   295→
   296→    if (currentStroke.length > 1) {
   297→      const shapeType = isAnnotateMode && annotationMode ? annotationMode : 'line';
   298→
   299→      // For rectangles, require minimum drag distance
   300→      if (shapeType === 'rectangle') {
   301→        const startPoint = currentStroke[0];
   302→        const endPoint = currentStroke[currentStroke.length - 1];
   303→        const dragDistance = Math.hypot(endPoint.x - startPoint.x, endPoint.y - startPoint.y);
   304→        if (dragDistance < 10) {
   305→          setCurrentStroke([]);
   306→          return;
   307→        }
   308→      }
   309→
   310→      const strokePoints = shapeType === 'rectangle'
   311→        ? [currentStroke[0], currentStroke[currentStroke.length - 1]]
   312→        : currentStroke;
   313→
   314→      const newStroke: BrushStroke = {
   315→        id: nanoid(),
   316→        points: strokePoints,
   317→        isErasing: isEraseMode,
   318→        brushSize: brushSize,
   319→        shapeType
   320→      };
   321→
   322→      // Limit to one rectangle in annotate mode
   323→      if (isAnnotateMode && shapeType === 'rectangle' && annotationStrokes.length > 0) {
   324→        console.log('[Annotate] Replacing existing rectangle');
   325→        setAnnotationStrokes([newStroke]);
   326→      } else {
   327→        console.log('[Inpaint] Adding new stroke');
   328→        if (isAnnotateMode) {
   329→          setAnnotationStrokes(prev => [...prev, newStroke]);
   330→        } else {
   331→          setBrushStrokes(prev => [...prev, newStroke]);
   332→        }
   333→      }
   334→
   335→      // Auto-select rectangle after drawing
   336→      if (isAnnotateMode && shapeType === 'rectangle') {
   337→        setSelectedShapeId(newStroke.id);
   338→      }
   339→
   340→      console.log('[Inpaint] Stroke added', {
   341→        strokeId: newStroke.id,
   342→        shapeType,
   343→        points: newStroke.points.map(p => ({ x: Math.round(p.x), y: Math.round(p.y) })),
   344→        mode: isAnnotateMode ? 'annotate' : 'inpaint',
   345→      });
   346→    }
   347→
   348→    setCurrentStroke([]);
   349→  }, [isInpaintMode, isDrawing, currentStroke, isEraseMode, brushSize, isAnnotateMode, annotationMode, isDraggingShape, editMode, annotationStrokes.length, setBrushStrokes, setAnnotationStrokes, endDrag]);
```

## 7. onOpenChange HANDLER WITH cancel() AND allowPropagation()

### LightboxShell.tsx, Lines 415-422

```tsx
onOpenChange={(_open, eventDetails) => {
  // Prevent Base UI from updating internal state (which corrupts controlled open={true})
  // and from calling stopPropagation on the native event (which blocks our custom handlers).
  // Our own handlers in useLightboxNavigation (Escape) and handleOverlayClick (outside press)
  // manage all closing logic.
  eventDetails.cancel();
  eventDetails.allowPropagation();
}}
```

**What this does:**
1. **`eventDetails.cancel()`** - Prevents Base UI from changing internal `open` state
   - Keeps the dialog "always open" from Base UI's perspective
   - Real closing is managed by custom `onClose` callback
   
2. **`eventDetails.allowPropagation()`** - Permits the native event to bubble
   - Opposite of typical dialog behavior (which stops propagation)
   - Allows custom LightboxShell handlers to catch events first

**Keyboard Interaction Impact:**
- Escape key handling is done by `useLightboxNavigation` (not Base UI)
- Outside clicks are handled by custom `handleBgClickCapture` (not Base UI)
- **Positive:** Gives full control over close behavior
- **Negative:** Bypasses Base UI's built-in keyboard management entirely

## 10. DATA ATTRIBUTES FOR Z-INDEX TRACKING

### LightboxShell.tsx, Lines 58-80

Helper functions to detect higher z-index dialogs:

```tsx
function hasHigherZIndexDialog(): boolean {
  const dialogOverlays = document.querySelectorAll('[data-dialog-backdrop]');
  return Array.from(dialogOverlays).some((overlay) => {
    const zIndex = parseInt(window.getComputedStyle(overlay as Element).zIndex || '0', 10);
    return zIndex > 100000;
  });
}
```

**Used to prevent:**
- Closing when another dialog is open on top
- Processing keyboard events when another dialog owns focus

**Data attributes:**

- Used by LightboxShell, useLightboxNavigation, and other event handlers

## 11. VISUAL VIEWPORT TRACKING (Advanced iOS Safari Handling)

### LightboxShell.tsx, Lines 114-139

**useVisualViewport Hook:**
```tsx
function useVisualViewport() {
  const [rect, setRect] = useState(() => ({
    offsetTop: 0,
    height: window.visualViewport?.height ?? window.innerHeight,
  }));

  useEffect(() => {
    const vv = window.visualViewport;
    if (!vv) return;

    const update = () => {
      setRect({ offsetTop: vv.offsetTop, height: vv.height });
    };

    vv.addEventListener('resize', update);
    vv.addEventListener('scroll', update);
    update();

    return () => {
      vv.removeEventListener('resize', update);
      vv.removeEventListener('scroll', update);
    };
  }, []);

  return rect;
}
```

**Rationale (lines 107-112):**
```
On iOS Safari, the on-screen keyboard shifts the visual viewport without
resizing the layout viewport. Fixed elements anchored to the layout viewport
appear to shift. By tracking visualViewport we can size the overlay to match
what's actually visible, working *with* the keyboard rather than fighting it.
```

**Usage (lines 394-407):**
```tsx
const hasKeyboardOffset = vvTop > 0;
const contentStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  ...(needsFullscreenLayout
    ? hasKeyboardOffset
      ? { top: vvTop, left: 0, height: vvHeight }
      : { top: 0, left: 0, bottom: 0 }
    : {}),
};
```

**Analysis:**
- **POSITIVE:** Thoughtfully tracks when keyboard appears
- **POSITIVE:** Adjusts overlay position to match visual viewport
- **CONCERN:** Only applies to fullscreen layouts; centered layout still uses `calc(100vh - 220px)`

```
    56→// Props Interface
    57→// ============================================================================
    58→
    59→interface VideoLightboxProps {
    60→  /** Media to display. Optional in segment slot mode when no video exists (form-only). */
    61→  media?: GenerationRow;
    62→  onClose: () => void;
    63→  onNext?: () => void;
    64→  onPrevious?: () => void;
    65→  segmentSlotMode?: SegmentSlotModeData;
    66→  readOnly?: boolean;
    67→  showNavigation?: boolean;
    68→  showDownload?: boolean;
    69→  hasNext?: boolean;
    70→  hasPrevious?: boolean;
    71→  allShots?: ShotOption[];
    72→  selectedShotId?: string;
    73→  onShotChange?: (shotId: string) => void;
    74→  onAddToShot?: (targetShotId: string, generationId: string, imageUrl?: string, thumbUrl?: string) => Promise<boolean>;
    75→  onAddToShotWithoutPosition?: (targetShotId: string, generationId: string, imageUrl?: string, thumbUrl?: string) => Promise<boolean>;
    76→  onDelete?: (id: string) => void;
    77→  isDeleting?: string | null;
    78→  onApplySettings?: (metadata: GenerationRow['metadata']) => void;
    79→  showTickForImageId?: string | null;
    80→  onShowTick?: (imageId: string) => void;
    81→  showTickForSecondaryImageId?: string | null;
    82→  onShowSecondaryTick?: (imageId: string) => void;
    83→  starred?: boolean;
    84→  showTaskDetails?: boolean;
    85→  taskDetailsData?: TaskDetailsData;
    86→  onShowTaskDetails?: () => void;
    87→  onCreateShot?: (shotName: string, files: File[]) => Promise<{shotId?: string; shotName?: string} | void>;
    88→  onNavigateToShot?: (shot: Shot, options?: { isNewlyCreated?: boolean }) => void;
    89→  optimisticPositionedIds?: Set<string>;
    90→  optimisticUnpositionedIds?: Set<string>;
    91→  onOptimisticPositioned?: (mediaId: string, shotId: string) => void;
    92→  onOptimisticUnpositioned?: (mediaId: string, shotId: string) => void;
    93→  positionedInSelectedShot?: boolean;
    94→  associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot?: boolean;
    95→  onOpenExternalGeneration?: (generationId: string, derivedContext?: string[]) => Promise<void>;
    96→  shotId?: string;
    97→  tasksPaneOpen?: boolean;
    98→  tasksPaneWidth?: number;
    99→  initialVideoTrimMode?: boolean;
   100→  initialVariantId?: string;
   101→  fetchVariantsForSelf?: boolean;
   102→  currentSegmentImages?: {
   103→    startUrl?: string;
   104→    endUrl?: string;
   105→    startGenerationId?: string;
   106→    endGenerationId?: string;
   107→    startShotGenerationId?: string;
   108→    endShotGenerationId?: string;
   109→    activeChildGenerationId?: string;
   110→    startVariantId?: string;
   111→    endVariantId?: string;
   112→  };
   113→  onSegmentFrameCountChange?: (pairShotGenerationId: string, frameCount: number) => void;
   114→  currentFrameCount?: number;
   115→  onTrimModeChange?: (isTrimMode: boolean) => void;
   116→  adjacentSegments?: AdjacentSegmentsData;
   117→}
   118→
   119→// ============================================================================
   120→// Component
   121→// ============================================================================
   122→
   123→export const VideoLightbox: React.FC<VideoLightboxProps> = (props) => {
   124→  const {
   125→    media,
   126→    onClose,
   127→    onNext,
   128→    onPrevious,
   129→    segmentSlotMode,
   130→    readOnly = false,
   131→    showNavigation = true,
   132→    showDownload = true,
   133→    hasNext: hasNextProp = false,
   134→    hasPrevious: hasPreviousProp = false,
   135→    allShots,
   136→    selectedShotId,
   137→    onShotChange,
   138→    onAddToShot,
   139→    onAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   140→    onDelete,
   141→    isDeleting,
   142→    onApplySettings,
   143→    showTickForImageId,
   144→    onShowTick,
   145→    showTickForSecondaryImageId,
   146→    onShowSecondaryTick,
   147→    starred,
   148→    showTaskDetails = false,
   149→    taskDetailsData,
   150→    onShowTaskDetails,
   151→    onCreateShot,
   152→    onNavigateToShot,
   153→    optimisticPositionedIds,
   154→    optimisticUnpositionedIds,
   155→    onOptimisticPositioned,
   156→    onOptimisticUnpositioned,
   157→    positionedInSelectedShot,
   158→    associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot,
   159→    onOpenExternalGeneration,
   160→    shotId,
   161→    tasksPaneOpen,
   162→    tasksPaneWidth,
   163→    initialVideoTrimMode,
   164→    initialVariantId,
   165→    fetchVariantsForSelf,
   166→    currentSegmentImages,
   167→    onSegmentFrameCountChange,
   168→    currentFrameCount,
   169→    onTrimModeChange,
   170→    adjacentSegments,
   171→  } = props;
   172→
   173→  // ========================================
   174→  // SEGMENT SLOT MODE SETUP
   175→  // ========================================
   176→
   177→  const isSegmentSlotMode = !!segmentSlotMode;
   178→  const hasSegmentVideo = isSegmentSlotMode && !!segmentSlotMode.segmentVideo;
   179→  const isFormOnlyMode = isSegmentSlotMode && !hasSegmentVideo;
   180→
   181→  // Safety check - media is required unless we're in form-only mode
   182→  if (!media && !isFormOnlyMode) {
   183→    console.error('[VideoLightbox] ❌ No media prop provided and not in form-only mode!');
   184→    return null;
   185→  }
   186→
   187→  // Navigation in segment slot mode
   188→  const hasNext = isSegmentSlotMode
   189→    ? segmentSlotMode.currentIndex < segmentSlotMode.totalPairs - 1
   190→    : hasNextProp;
   191→  const hasPrevious = isSegmentSlotMode
   192→    ? segmentSlotMode.currentIndex > 0
   193→    : hasPreviousProp;
   194→
   195→  const handleSlotNavNext = useCallback(() => {
   196→    if (isSegmentSlotMode) {
   197→      segmentSlotMode.onNavigateToPair(segmentSlotMode.currentIndex + 1);
   198→    } else if (onNext) {
   199→      onNext();
   200→    }
   201→  }, [isSegmentSlotMode, segmentSlotMode, onNext]);
   202→
   203→  const handleSlotNavPrev = useCallback(() => {
   204→    if (isSegmentSlotMode) {
   205→      segmentSlotMode.onNavigateToPair(segmentSlotMode.currentIndex - 1);
   206→    } else if (onPrevious) {
   207→      onPrevious();
   208→    }
   209→  }, [isSegmentSlotMode, segmentSlotMode, onPrevious]);
   210→
   211→  // ========================================
   212→  // CORE SETUP
   213→  // ========================================
   214→
   215→  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
   216→  const { project, selectedProjectId } = useProject();
   217→  const projectAspectRatio = project?.aspect_ratio;
   218→  const { value: generationMethods } = useUserUIState('generationMethods', { onComputer: true, inCloud: true });
   219→  const isCloudMode = generationMethods.inCloud;
   220→
   221→  // Panes context for tasks pane
   222→  const {
   223→    isTasksPaneOpen: tasksPaneOpenContext,
   224→    setIsTasksPaneOpen: setTasksPaneOpenContext,
   225→    tasksPaneWidth: tasksPaneWidthContext,
   226→    isTasksPaneLocked,
   227→    setIsTasksPaneLocked,
   228→  } = usePanes();
   229→
   230→  const effectiveTasksPaneOpen = tasksPaneOpen ?? tasksPaneOpenContext;
   231→  const effectiveTasksPaneWidth = tasksPaneWidth ?? tasksPaneWidthContext;
   232→
   233→  const { data: statusCounts } = useTaskStatusCounts(selectedProjectId);
   234→  const cancellableTaskCount = statusCounts?.processing || 0;
   235→
   236→  // Refs
   237→  const contentRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
   238→  const variantsSectionRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
   239→
   240→  // State
   241→  const [isDownloading, setIsDownloading] = useState(false);
   242→  const [isSelectOpen, setIsSelectOpen] = useState(false);
   243→  const [replaceImages, setReplaceImages] = useState(true);
   244→  const [variantParamsToLoad, setVariantParamsToLoad] = useState<Record<string, unknown> | null>(null);
   245→
   246→  // Compute actual generation ID
   247→  // For timeline media, media.id is shot_generations.id, not the generation ID
   248→  // So we need to prefer media.generation_id for variant fetching
   249→  const actualGenerationId = getGenerationId(media) || null;
   250→  const variantFetchGenerationId = fetchVariantsForSelf
   251→    ? actualGenerationId
   252→    : (media?.parent_generation_id || actualGenerationId);
   253→
   254→  // ========================================
   255→  // VIDEO EDIT SUB-MODE STATE
   256→  // ========================================
   257→
   258→  const [videoEditSubMode, setVideoEditSubModeLocal] = useState<'trim' | 'replace' | 'regenerate' | 'enhance' | null>(() => {
   259→    if (initialVideoTrimMode) return 'trim';
   260→    // Check localStorage for persisted mode
   261→    try {
   262→      const [REDACTED] ? `lightbox-edit-last-used-${selectedProjectId}` : null;
   263→      const stored = projectKey ? localStorage.getItem(projectKey) : localStorage.getItem('lightbox-edit-last-used-global');
   264→      if (stored) {
   265→        const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
   266→        if (parsed.panelMode === 'edit' && parsed.videoEditSubMode) {
   267→          return parsed.videoEditSubMode;
   268→        }
   269→      }
   270→    } catch (e) {
   271→      // Ignore localStorage errors
   272→    }
   273→    return null;
   274→  });
   275→
   276→  // ========================================
   277→  // EDIT SETTINGS PERSISTENCE
   278→  // ========================================
   279→
   280→  const editSettingsPersistence = useEditSettingsPersistence({
   281→    generationId: actualGenerationId,
   282→    projectId: selectedProjectId,
   283→    enabled: !isFormOnlyMode,
   284→  });
   285→
   286→  const {
   287→    enhanceSettings,
   288→    setEnhanceSettings,
   289→    videoEditSubMode: persistedVideoEditSubMode,
   290→    panelMode: persistedPanelMode,
   291→    setVideoEditSubMode: setPersistedVideoEditSubMode,
   292→    setPanelMode: setPersistedPanelMode,
   293→  } = editSettingsPersistence;
   294→
   295→  // Wrapper for setVideoEditSubMode that also persists
   296→  const setVideoEditSubMode = useCallback((mode: 'trim' | 'replace' | 'regenerate' | null) => {
   297→    setVideoEditSubModeLocal(mode);
   298→    if (mode) {
   299→      setPersistedVideoEditSubMode(mode);
   300→    }
   301→  }, [setPersistedVideoEditSubMode]);
   302→
   303→  // ========================================
   304→  // IMAGE DIMENSIONS (for video thumbnails)
   305→  // ========================================
   306→
   307→  const resolutionToDimensions = (resolution: string): { width: number; height: number } | null => {
   308→    if (!resolution || typeof resolution !== 'string' || !resolution.includes('x')) return null;
   309→    const [w, h] = resolution.split('x').map(Number);
   310→    if (!isNaN(w) && !isNaN(h) && w > 0 && h > 0) {
   311→      return { width: w, height: h };
   312→    }
   313→    return null;
   314→  };
   315→
   316→  const aspectRatioToDimensions = (aspectRatio: string): { width: number; height: number } | null => {
   317→    if (!aspectRatio) return null;
   318→    const directResolution = ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION[aspectRatio];
   319→    if (directResolution) return resolutionToDimensions(directResolution);
   320→    const ratio = parseRatio(aspectRatio);
   321→    if (!isNaN(ratio)) {
   322→      const closestAspectRatio = findClosestAspectRatio(ratio);
   323→      const closestResolution = ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION[closestAspectRatio];
   324→      if (closestResolution) return resolutionToDimensions(closestResolution);
   325→    }
   326→    return null;
   327→  };
   328→
   329→  const extractDimensionsFromMedia = useCallback((mediaObj: typeof media): { width: number; height: number } | null => {
   330→    if (!mediaObj) return null;
   331→    const params = mediaObj.params as GenerationParams | undefined;
   332→    const metadata = mediaObj.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   333→
   334→    // Check metadata for width/height (these may exist as extended metadata fields)
   335→    if (metadata?.width && metadata?.height && typeof metadata.width === 'number' && typeof metadata.height === 'number') {
   336→      return { width: metadata.width, height: metadata.height };
   337→    }
   338→
   339→    const resolutionSources = [
   340→      params?.resolution,
   341→      (params as Record<string, unknown>)?.originalParams,
   342→      metadata?.resolution,
   343→    ];
   344→    for (const res of resolutionSources) {
   345→      if (typeof res === 'string') {
   346→        const dims = resolutionToDimensions(res);
   347→        if (dims) return dims;
   348→      }
   349→    }
   350→
   351→    const aspectRatioSources = [
   352→      params?.aspect_ratio,
   353→      metadata?.aspect_ratio,
   354→    ];
   355→    for (const ar of aspectRatioSources) {
   356→      if (ar && typeof ar === 'string') {
   357→        const dims = aspectRatioToDimensions(ar);
   358→        if (dims) return dims;
   359→      }
   360→    }
   361→
   362→    return null;
   363→  }, []);
   364→
   365→  const [imageDimensions, setImageDimensions] = useState<{ width: number; height: number } | null>(() => {
   366→    return media ? extractDimensionsFromMedia(media) : null;
   367→  });
   368→
   369→  React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
   370→    if (!media) return;
   371→    const dims = extractDimensionsFromMedia(media);
   372→    if (dims) setImageDimensions(dims);
   373→  }, [media?.id, extractDimensionsFromMedia]);
   374→
   375→  // Effective URL for video (the video URL, not thumbnail)
   376→  // This is used as fallback in useEffectiveMedia when there's no activeVariant
   377→  const effectiveImageUrl = media?.imageUrl || media?.location || '';
   378→
   379→  // ========================================
   380→  // SHARED LIGHTBOX STATE
   381→  // ========================================
   382→
   383→  const sharedState = useSharedLightboxState({
   384→    media: media || ({} as GenerationRow), // Provide empty object for form-only mode
   385→    isVideo: true,
   386→    selectedProjectId,
   387→    isMobile,
   388→    isFormOnlyMode,
   389→    onClose,
   390→    readOnly,
   391→    variantFetchGenerationId,
   392→    initialVariantId,
   393→    showNavigation,
   394→    hasNext,
   395→    hasPrevious,
   396→    handleSlotNavNext,
   397→    handleSlotNavPrev,
   398→    shotId,
   399→    selectedShotId,
   400→    allShots,
   401→    onShotChange,
   402→    onAddToShot,
   403→    onAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   404→    onNavigateToShot,
   405→    onShowTick,
   406→    onShowSecondaryTick,
   407→    onOptimisticPositioned,
   408→    onOptimisticUnpositioned,
   409→    optimisticPositionedIds,
   410→    optimisticUnpositionedIds,
   411→    positionedInSelectedShot,
   412→    associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot,
   413→    starred,
   414→    onOpenExternalGeneration,
   415→    showTaskDetails,
   416→    isSpecialEditMode: videoEditSubMode !== null,
   417→    isInpaintMode: false,
   418→    isMagicEditMode: false,
   419→    isCloudMode,
   420→    showDownload,
   421→    isDownloading,
   422→    setIsDownloading,
   423→    onDelete,
   424→    isDeleting,
   425→    // Upscale is image-only, but button group needs these
   426→    isUpscaling: false,
   427→    isPendingUpscale: false,
   428→    hasUpscaledVersion: false,
   429→    showingUpscaled: false,
   430→    handleUpscale: () => {},
   431→    handleToggleUpscaled: () => {},
   432→    handleEnterMagicEditMode: () => {},
   433→    effectiveImageUrl,
   434→    imageDimensions: imageDimensions || { width: 1024, height: 576 },
   435→    projectAspectRatio,
   436→    swipeDisabled: videoEditSubMode !== null || readOnly,
   437→  });
   438→
   439→  const {
   440→    variants,
   441→    intendedActiveVariantIdRef,
   442→    navigation,
   443→    star,
   444→    references,
   445→    lineage,
   446→    shots,
   447→    sourceGeneration,
   448→    makeMainVariant,
   449→    effectiveMedia,
   450→    layout,
   451→    buttonGroupProps,
   452→  } = sharedState;
   453→
   454→  // ========================================
   455→  // ADJUSTED TASK DETAILS
   456→  // ========================================
   457→
   458→  const { adjustedTaskDetailsData } = useAdjustedTaskDetails({
   459→    activeVariant: variants.activeVariant,
   460→    taskDetailsData,
   461→    isLoadingVariants: variants.isLoading,
   462→    initialVariantId,
   463→  });
   464→
   465→  // ========================================
   466→  // VIDEO REGENERATE MODE
   467→  // ========================================
   468→
   469→  const { canRegenerate, regenerateFormProps } = useVideoRegenerateMode({
   470→    isVideo: true,
   471→    media: media || ({} as GenerationRow),
   472→    shotId,
   473→    selectedProjectId,
   474→    actualGenerationId,
   475→    adjustedTaskDetailsData,
   476→    primaryVariant: variants.primaryVariant,
   477→    currentSegmentImages,
   478→    segmentSlotMode,
   479→    variantParamsToLoad,
   480→    setVariantParamsToLoad,
   481→    onSegmentFrameCountChange: segmentSlotMode?.onFrameCountChange ?? onSegmentFrameCountChange,
   482→    currentFrameCount,
   483→  });
   484→
   485→  // ========================================
   486→  // VIDEO MODE HOOK (consolidated)
   487→  // ========================================
   488→
   489→  const videoMode = useLightboxVideoMode({
   490→    media: media || ({} as GenerationRow),
   491→    isVideo: true,
   492→    selectedProjectId,
   493→    projectAspectRatio,
   494→    shotId,
   495→    actualGenerationId,
   496→    effectiveVideoUrl: effectiveMedia.videoUrl,
   497→    activeVariant: variants.activeVariant,
   498→    setActiveVariantId: variants.setActiveVariantId,
   499→    refetchVariants: variants.refetch,
   500→    videoEditSubMode,
   501→    setVideoEditSubMode,
   502→    persistedVideoEditSubMode,
   503→    setPersistedPanelMode,
   504→    enhanceSettings,
   505→    setEnhanceSettings,
   506→    onTrimModeChange,
   507→    canRegenerate,
   508→  });
   509→
   510→  const {
   511→    trimVideoRef,
   512→    trimState,
   513→    trimCurrentTime,
   514→    setTrimCurrentTime,
   515→    trimmedDuration,
   516→    hasTrimChanges,
   517→    setStartTrim,
   518→    setEndTrim,
   519→    resetTrim,
   520→    setVideoDuration,
   521→    isSavingTrim,
   522→    trimSaveProgress,
   523→    trimSaveError,
   524→    trimSaveSuccess,
   525→    saveTrimmedVideo,
   526→    videoEditing,
   527→    videoEnhance,
   528→    handleEnterVideoEditMode,
   529→    handleExitVideoEditMode,
   530→    handleEnterVideoTrimMode,
   531→    handleEnterVideoReplaceMode,
   532→    handleEnterVideoRegenerateMode,
   533→    handleEnterVideoEnhanceMode,
   534→    handleExitVideoTrimMode,
   535→    isVideoTrimMode,
   536→    isInVideoEditMode,
   537→    isVideoTrimModeActive,
   538→    isVideoEditModeActive,
   539→  } = videoMode;
   540→
   541→  // ========================================
   542→  // PANEL MODE RESTORE
   543→  // ========================================
   544→
   545→  usePanelModeRestore({
   546→    mediaId: media?.id || '',
   547→    persistedPanelMode,
   548→    isVideo: true,
   549→    isSpecialEditMode: false, // Videos don't have image edit modes
   550→    isInVideoEditMode,
   551→    initialVideoTrimMode,
   552→    autoEnterInpaint: false,
   553→    handleEnterVideoEditMode,
   554→    handleEnterMagicEditMode: () => {},
   555→  });
   556→
   557→  // ========================================
   558→  // LOAD VARIANT SETTINGS FOR VIDEO
   559→  // ========================================
   560→
   561→  useEffect(() => {
   562→    if (!variantParamsToLoad || isFormOnlyMode) return;
   563→
   564→    const taskType = variantParamsToLoad.task_type || variantParamsToLoad.created_from;
   565→
   566→    if (taskType === 'video_enhance') {
   567→      handleEnterVideoEnhanceMode();
   568→      setEnhanceSettings({
   569→        enableInterpolation: variantParamsToLoad.enable_interpolation ?? false,
   570→        enableUpscale: variantParamsToLoad.enable_upscale ?? true,
   571→        numFrames: variantParamsToLoad.num_frames ?? 1,
   572→        upscaleFactor: variantParamsToLoad.upscale_factor ?? 2,
   573→        colorFix: variantParamsToLoad.color_fix ?? true,
   574→        outputQuality: variantParamsToLoad.output_quality ?? 'high',
   575→      });
   576→      setVariantParamsToLoad(null);
   577→    } else {
   578→      // Travel segment variant - switch to regenerate mode
   579→      handleEnterVideoRegenerateMode();
   580→    }
   581→  }, [
   582→    variantParamsToLoad,
   583→    isFormOnlyMode,
   584→    handleEnterVideoEnhanceMode,
   585→    handleEnterVideoRegenerateMode,
   586→    setEnhanceSettings,
   587→    setVariantParamsToLoad,
   588→  ]);
   589→
   590→  // ========================================
   591→  // PENDING TASKS
   592→  // ========================================
   593→
   594→  const pendingTaskGenerationId = regenerateFormProps?.pairShotGenerationId || actualGenerationId;
   595→  const { pendingCount: pendingTaskCount } = usePendingGenerationTasks(pendingTaskGenerationId, selectedProjectId);
   596→
   597→  const unviewedVariantCount = useMemo(() => {
   598→    if (!variants.list || variants.list.length === 0) return 0;
   599→    return variants.list.filter((v) => v.viewed_at === null).length;
   600→  }, [variants.list]);
   601→
   602→  const { markAllViewed: markAllViewedMutation } = useMarkVariantViewed();
   603→  const handleMarkAllViewed = useCallback(() => {
   604→    if (variantFetchGenerationId) {
   605→      markAllViewedMutation(variantFetchGenerationId);
   606→    }
   607→  }, [markAllViewedMutation, variantFetchGenerationId]);
   608→
   609→  // ========================================
   610→  // LOAD VARIANT IMAGES
   611→  // ========================================
   612→
   613→  // Build currentSegmentImages for variant comparison
   614→  // In segment slot mode, use pairData from timeline; otherwise use the prop
   615→  const variantSegmentImages = useMemo(() => {
   616→    if (segmentSlotMode?.pairData) {
   617→      return {
   618→        startUrl: segmentSlotMode.pairData.startImage?.url,
   619→        endUrl: segmentSlotMode.pairData.endImage?.url,
   620→        startGenerationId: segmentSlotMode.pairData.startImage?.generationId,
   621→        endGenerationId: segmentSlotMode.pairData.endImage?.generationId,
   622→        startShotGenerationId: segmentSlotMode.pairData.startImage?.id,
   623→        endShotGenerationId: segmentSlotMode.pairData.endImage?.id,
   624→        startVariantId: segmentSlotMode.pairData.startImage?.primaryVariantId,
   625→        endVariantId: segmentSlotMode.pairData.endImage?.primaryVariantId,
   626→      };
   627→    }
   628→    return currentSegmentImages;
   629→  }, [segmentSlotMode?.pairData, currentSegmentImages]);
   630→
   631→  const { loadVariantImages } = useLoadVariantImages({
   632→    currentSegmentImages: variantSegmentImages,
   633→  });
   634→
   635→  // ========================================
   636→  // CONTEXT VALUE
   637→  // ========================================
   638→
   639→  const lightboxStateValue = useLightboxStateValue({
   640→    onClose,
   641→    readOnly,
   642→    isMobile,
   643→    isTabletOrLarger: layout.isTabletOrLarger,
   644→    selectedProjectId,
   645→    actualGenerationId,
   646→    media: media || ({} as GenerationRow),
   647→    isVideo: true,
   648→    effectiveMediaUrl: effectiveMedia.mediaUrl,
   649→    effectiveVideoUrl: effectiveMedia.videoUrl,
   650→    effectiveImageDimensions: effectiveMedia.imageDimensions,
   651→    imageDimensions,
   652→    setImageDimensions,
   653→    variants: variants.list,
   654→    activeVariant: variants.activeVariant,
   655→    primaryVariant: variants.primaryVariant,
   656→    isLoadingVariants: variants.isLoading,
   657→    setActiveVariantId: variants.setActiveVariantId,
   658→    setPrimaryVariant: variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   659→    deleteVariant: variants.deleteVariant,
   660→    onLoadVariantSettings: setVariantParamsToLoad,
   661→    onLoadVariantImages: variantSegmentImages ? loadVariantImages : undefined,
   662→    currentSegmentImages: variantSegmentImages,
   663→    promoteSuccess: variants.promoteSuccess,
```

```
   152→    const lockScroll = () => window.scrollTo(0, savedScrollY);
   153→    window.addEventListener('scroll', lockScroll);
   154→

   167→  // ========================================
   168→  // OVERLAY EVENT HANDLERS (Backdrop layer)
   169→  // ========================================
   170→  // Active when needsFullscreenLayout=false (non-fullscreen video layouts).
   171→  // In fullscreen layouts the Popup covers the Backdrop, so these don't fire —
   172→  // close-on-click is handled by the capture-phase handlers below instead.

   174→  const handleOverlayPointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {

   177→    if (hasHigherZIndexDialog() || targetHasHigherZIndex(e.target)) {

   208→    e.preventDefault();
   209→    e.stopPropagation();
   210→    if (e.nativeEvent && typeof e.nativeEvent.stopImmediatePropagation === 'function') {

   228→    const clickEndedOnOverlay = e.target === e.currentTarget;
   229→
   230→    if (clickStartedOnOverlay && clickEndedOnOverlay) {

   232→    }

   234→    pointerDownTargetRef.current = null;

   236→
   237→  // ========================================
   238→  // STANDARDIZED BACKGROUND CLICK-TO-CLOSE
   239→  // ========================================
   240→  // Uses capture phase on the Popup so it fires before any child handler.
   241→  // Layouts mark their background elements with data-lightbox-bg.
   242→  // This is the ONE place that handles click-to-close for all layouts.

   244→  const handleBgPointerDownCapture = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
   245→    bgPointerDownTargetRef.current = e.target;
   246→  };

   248→  const handleBgClickCapture = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {

   252→
   253→    if (hasHigherZIndexDialog() || targetHasHigherZIndex(upTarget)) return;

   256→    if (isRepositionMode) return;

   258→    // Both pointerdown and click must land directly on a background element

   325→    cursor: 'pointer', // Required for iOS touch events

   327→    position: 'fixed',
   328→    top: 0,
   329→    left: 0,
   330→    right: shouldAccountForTasksPane ? `${effectiveTasksPaneWidth}px` : 0,

   336→  };
   337→
   338→  // ========================================
   339→  // CONTENT STYLES
   340→  // ========================================
   341→
   342→  const contentStyle: React.CSSProperties = {

   344→    ...(needsTasksPaneOffset

   346→      : needsFullscreenLayout
   347→      ? { width: '100vw' }
   348→      : {}),
   349→  };
```

```
   163→
   164→  // Dispatch based on media type

   170→      />

   174→  // Image media
   175→  return (
   176→    <ImageLightbox
   177→      media={media}
   178→      {...restProps}
   179→    />
   180→  );
   181→};
```

```
130→  // On phones, modal={true} handles scroll locking. On desktop and iPad,
   131→  // modal={false} (to allow TasksPane interaction), so we lock via CSS.
   132→  //
   133→  // We use overflow:hidden + overscroll-behavior:none on html/body instead of
   134→  // position:fixed on body.  The position:fixed approach fights with iOS Safari's
   135→  // keyboard viewport management — when the on-screen keyboard appears, the body's
   136→  // artificial repositioning (top: -scrollY) conflicts with the visual viewport
   137→  // shift, causing the overlay to displace and dirty state to accumulate.
   138→  //
   139→  // The overlay's own touch-action:none (backdrop, image area) and
   140→  // overscroll-behavior:contain (panel) provide the primary scroll prevention;
   141→  // the CSS class is a safety net.
   142→  const isActuallyModal = isMobile && !isTabletOrLarger;
   143→  useEffect(() => {
   144→    if (isActuallyModal) return; // modal={true} handles scroll locking
   145→
   146→    const savedScrollY = window.scrollY;
   147→    document.documentElement.classList.add('lightbox-open');
   148→
   149→    // iOS Safari can scroll the body despite overflow:hidden (WebKit bug #153852).
   150→    // Actively undo any scroll that sneaks through while the lightbox is open.
   151→    // The overlay covers the viewport so this is invisible to the user.
   152→    const lockScroll = () => window.scrollTo(0, savedScrollY);
   153→    window.addEventListener('scroll', lockScroll);
   154→
   155→    return () => {
   156→      window.removeEventListener('scroll', lockScroll);
   157→      // Dismiss keyboard to reset visual viewport offset before removing lock.
   158→      if (document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement) {
   159→        document.activeElement.blur();
   160→      }
   161→      document.documentElement.classList.remove('lightbox-open');
   162→      // Restore scroll position in case iOS moved it.
   163→      window.scrollTo(0, savedScrollY);
   164→    };
   165→  }, [isActuallyModal]);
```

Perfect! Now I have all the information I need. Let me create a comprehensive summary report:

## Findings: Image vs Video Lightbox Differences

I've thoroughly analyzed the MediaLightbox system and found **a critical architectural difference** that causes the viewport shift issue. Here are the key findings:

### THE ROOT CAUSE: `needsFullscreenLayout` Logic Differs

**ImageLightbox (line 1023):**
```
const needsFullscreenLayout = true;  // ALWAYS fullscreen
```

**VideoLightbox (line 810):**
```
const needsFullscreenLayout = isMobile || isFormOnlyMode || layout.shouldShowSidePanel || shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim;
// Can be FALSE on desktop without side panel
```

### The Problem Chain

1. **Layout Calculation via `useLayoutMode` (line 42 in `useLayoutMode.ts`):**
   ```typescript
   const shouldShowSidePanel = !isPortrait && 
     ((showTaskDetails && isTabletOrLarger) || 
      (isSpecialEditMode && isTabletOrLarger) ||  // <- Critical for videos!
      (isVideo && isTabletOrLarger));
   ```

2. **How Videos Differ (VideoLightbox line 416):**
   ```typescript
   isSpecialEditMode: videoEditSubMode !== null,
   ```
   
   When you enter video trim/replace/regenerate mode, `videoEditSubMode` becomes non-null, so `isSpecialEditMode=true`. This triggers `shouldShowSidePanel=true`, which then makes `needsFullscreenLayout=true` (line 810).

3. **How Images Work (ImageLightbox line 400):**
   ```typescript
   isSpecialEditMode: isMagicEditModeLocal,
   ```
   
   Image edit modes only enable if inpaint/magic edit is active. Simple image viewing has `isSpecialEditMode=false`, so `shouldShowSidePanel=false`, but `needsFullscreenLayout=true` (always forced).

4. **Scroll Lock Behavior (LightboxShell lines 142-165):**
   ```typescript
   const isActuallyModal = isMobile && !isTabletOrLarger;  // Only TRUE on phones
   useEffect(() => {
     if (isActuallyModal) return;  // Skip CSS locking on phones
     
     // On desktop: add lightbox-open class to html/body for overflow:hidden
     document.documentElement.classList.add('lightbox-open');
     window.addEventListener('scroll', lockScroll);  // Lock scroll with JS
     
     return () => {
       window.removeEventListener('scroll', lockScroll);
       document.documentElement.classList.remove('lightbox-open');
     };
   }, [isActuallyModal]);
   ```

### What Happens When You Click a Video Lightbox

1. **VideoLightbox mounts** with `videoEditSubMode=null` initially
   - `needsFullscreenLayout=false` (on desktop)
   - No scroll lock effect runs
2. **Overlay shifts up** (user reports this)
3. **Next lightbox opens** (image or video)
   - Previous VideoLightbox unmounts → cleanup runs
   - New lightbox mounts
   - But the scroll lock state is now inconsistent or the overlay calculation uses stale values

### Why Images Work Fine

- **Always `needsFullscreenLayout=true`**, so the scroll lock effect is consistent
- The overlay styling (line 322-336 in LightboxShell) works predictably
- No state-dependent changes to the fullscreen layout prop during component lifecycle

### The Triggering Events

**File locations and critical differences:**

| Aspect | Video | Image |
|--------|-------|-------|
| Component | `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/VideoLightbox.tsx` | `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/ImageLightbox.tsx` |
| needsFullscreenLayout | Line 810 - Conditional | Line 1023 - Always `true` |
| isSpecialEditMode passed to hook | Line 416: `videoEditSubMode !== null` | Line 400: `isMagicEditModeLocal` |
| Scroll lock handled by | LightboxShell (line 143-165) | LightboxShell (line 143-165) |
| Layout decision hook | useLayoutMode (line 42 in `useLayoutMode.ts`) | Same hook |

### Key Invariants That Break

1. **LightboxShell useEffect dependency (line 165):** Only depends on `[isActuallyModal]`
   - When VideoLightbox's `needsFullscreenLayout` changes, scroll lock state doesn't update
   - When switching from video → image, cleanup may run at wrong time

2. **Overlay style transition (line 332):** Has a 300ms transition
   - But if scroll lock is applied/removed mid-transition, it causes jumps

3. **ContentStyle width calculation (lines 342-349):**
   - Depends on `needsTasksPaneOffset` and `needsFullscreenLayout`
   - If these values change between mount/unmount cycles, width calculations mismatch

### Files to Review for Fix

All changes centralize around these files:

1. **`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/VideoLightbox.tsx`** (Line 810)
   - Make `needsFullscreenLayout` calculation consistent with ImageLightbox

2. **`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/ImageLightbox.tsx`** (Line 1023)
   - Reference implementation for "always fullscreen"

3. **`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/components/LightboxShell.tsx`** (Lines 142-165)
   - Scroll lock effect may need defensive updates or different dependency

4. **`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/hooks/useLayoutMode.ts`** (Line 42)
   - Where `shouldShowSidePanel` logic determines layout

5. **`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/index.css`**
   - CSS scroll lock rule for `html.lightbox-open`

<summary>
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The conversation had two main threads:
   - **Blog section**: Implement a `/blog` section with a static markdown blog, push to GitHub, add before/after image placeholders
   - **iOS Safari overlay fix (main focus)**: Fix the lightbox overlay shifting issue on iPad when the on-screen keyboard appears. This evolved from a simple fix attempt into deep research and multiple implementation iterations. The user specifically wanted a fundamentally sound, cross-device solution that works "with" the platform rather than fighting it.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **iOS Safari visual viewport vs layout viewport**: The on-screen keyboard shifts the visual viewport without resizing the layout viewport. `position: fixed` elements anchor to the layout viewport, appearing displaced.
   - **`touch-action` ancestor intersection rule**: `touch-action` values are intersected across all ancestors, not overridden by children. `none ∩ pan-y = none`. This means `touch-action: none` on body kills scrolling in all descendants including the lightbox panel.
   - **`position: fixed` on body conflicts with iOS keyboard**: The body `position: fixed; top: -scrollYpx` hack fights with iOS Safari's keyboard viewport management, causing dirty state accumulation.
   - **`overflow: hidden` unreliability on iOS Safari**: WebKit bug #153852 - `overflow: hidden` alone doesn't prevent touch scrolling on iOS Safari.
   - **`interactive-widget=resizes-content`**: NOT supported in Safari (WebKit bug #259770). Only works in Chromium.
   - **`overscroll-behavior: none`**: Supported in Safari 16+. Combined with `overflow: hidden` as a more reliable scroll prevention.
   - **`window.visualViewport` API**: Tracks actual visible area. `offsetTop` and `height` change when keyboard appears. Supported Safari 13+.
   - **`dvh` units**: Respond to address bar changes but NOT to keyboard on Safari.
   - **`import.meta.glob`**: Vite feature for loading files at build time (used for blog posts).
   - **`needsFullscreenLayout` difference**: ImageLightbox always `true`, VideoLightbox conditional - identified as likely root cause of the persistent shift issue.

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - **`src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/components/LightboxShell.tsx`** (MOST CRITICAL)
     - Central file for all iOS Safari fixes. Modified multiple times.
     - Current state: CSS-only scroll lock with scroll position locking + blur-on-close
     ```tsx
     const isActuallyModal = isMobile && !isTabletOrLarger;
     useEffect(() => {
       if (isActuallyModal) return;
       const savedScrollY = window.scrollY;
       document.documentElement.classList.add('lightbox-open');
       const lockScroll = () => window.scrollTo(0, savedScrollY);
       window.addEventListener('scroll', lockScroll);
       return () => {
         window.removeEventListener('scroll', lockScroll);
         if (document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement) {
           document.activeElement.blur();
         }
         document.documentElement.classList.remove('lightbox-open');
         window.scrollTo(0, savedScrollY);
       };
     }, [isActuallyModal]);
     ```
     - Removed: `useVisualViewport` hook, `useState` import, body `position: fixed` scroll lock with save/restore
     - Reverted: Popup fullscreen className back to `"inset-0 w-full h-full"`, content style back to simple width-only
     - Overlay style: simple `top: 0, left: 0, right: X, bottom: 0` (no visual viewport tracking)

   - **`src/index.css`** (lines ~319-328)
     - Added CSS-only lightbox scroll lock class:
     ```css
     html.lightbox-open,
     html.lightbox-open body {
       overflow: hidden;
       overscroll-behavior: none;
     }
     ```

   - **`index.html`**
     - Viewport meta tag reverted to original (removed `interactive-widget=resizes-content`):
     ```html
     <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover" />
     ```

   - **`src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/VideoLightbox.tsx`** (line 810)
     - Key finding: `needsFullscreenLayout` is CONDITIONAL for video:
     ```tsx

     ```

   - **`src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/ImageLightbox.tsx`** (line 1023)


4. Errors and fixes:
   - **`.gitignore` blocking blog post**: `*.md` in `.gitignore` prevented committing the blog post. Fixed by adding `!docs/blog/*.md` exception.
   - **GitHub PR creation failed**: Repo moved from `peteromallet/Reigh` to `banodoco/Reigh`. Fixed by using `--head blog/add-blog-section` flag with `gh pr create`.
   - **`interactive-widget=resizes-content` does nothing on Safari**: Added to viewport meta tag, user reported no fix. Research confirmed WebKit bug #259770 - not implemented. Reverted.
   - **Visual viewport tracking caused gap WITHOUT keyboard**: `visualViewport.height` differs from layout viewport height due to address bar. Fixed by only applying visual viewport sizing when `vvTop > 0`.
   - **Visual viewport tracking still caused gap**: Even with `vvTop > 0` check, the approach was fighting symptoms not causes. User said "think about this differently." Led to removing visual viewport tracking entirely.
   - **CSS-only scroll lock (`overflow: hidden`) intermittent failures**: WebKit bug #153852 - `overflow: hidden` doesn't reliably prevent body scroll on iOS Safari. Fixed by adding scroll event listener to actively undo any scroll that sneaks through.
   - **Persistent brokenness after video lightbox**: Identified `needsFullscreenLayout` difference between ImageLightbox (always `true`) and VideoLightbox (conditional). NOT YET FIXED.

5. Problem Solving:
   - **Blog section**: Fully implemented and merged to main. PR #1 created and closed on banodoco/Reigh.
   - **iOS Safari keyboard overlay shift**: Multiple approaches tried:
     1. `interactive-widget=resizes-content` → Safari doesn't support it
     2. Visual viewport tracking (useVisualViewport hook) → `visualViewport.height` mismatch with layout viewport
     3. Conditional visual viewport (only when `vvTop > 0`) → Still gap issues
     4. CSS-only body scroll lock → Works sometimes, not others (iOS overflow:hidden bug)
     5. CSS + scroll event listener + blur-on-close → Current approach, but intermittent
   - **Root cause identified but not yet fixed**: VideoLightbox's conditional `needsFullscreenLayout` causes different CSS paths (centered vs fullscreen), which likely causes the viewport shift when transitioning from image to video lightboxes.

8. Current Work:
   We just identified the likely root cause of the persistent overlay shift issue. The user reported: "so here's the weird thing, I can click into multple image lightboxes, but then when iclick into a video one, it feels like something shifts up and then all the rest are broken"

   Investigation revealed:
   - **ImageLightbox** (line 1023): `const needsFullscreenLayout = true;` (always fullscreen)
   - **VideoLightbox** (line 810): `const needsFullscreenLayout = isMobile || isFormOnlyMode || layout.shouldShowSidePanel || shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim;` (conditional)

   When a video lightbox opens on desktop/tablet without a side panel active, `needsFullscreenLayout` can be `false`. This changes the Popup's CSS classes from `"inset-0 w-full h-full"` (fullscreen) to centered positioning (`"left-[50%] top-[50%] translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%]"`), which likely causes the layout shift. Once the viewport/scroll state is corrupted, subsequent lightboxes inherit the dirty state.

9. Optional Next Step:

The immediate question is whether VideoLightbox should also always use `needsFullscreenLayout = true` (like ImageLightbox), or whether there's a specific reason it's conditional.
