   245→  const handleSaveAsShotDefaults = useCallback(async () => {
   246→    if (!onSaveAsShotDefaults) return;
   247→    setIsSavingDefaults(true);
   248→    setSaveDefaultsSuccess(false);
   249→    try {
   250→      const success = await onSaveAsShotDefaults();
   251→      if (success) {
   252→        setSaveDefaultsSuccess(true);
   253→        setTimeout(() => setSaveDefaultsSuccess(false), 2000);
   254→      }
   255→    } finally {
   256→      setIsSavingDefaults(false);
   257→    }
   258→  }, [onSaveAsShotDefaults]);
   259→
   260→  const handleSaveFieldAsDefault = useCallback(async (field: keyof SegmentSettings, value: SegmentSettings[keyof SegmentSettings]) => {
   261→    if (!onSaveFieldAsDefault) return;
   262→    setSavingField(field);
   263→    try {
   264→      const success = await onSaveFieldAsDefault(field, value);
   265→      if (success) {
   266→        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
   267→        onChange({ [field]: undefined } as Partial<SegmentSettings>);
   268→      }
   269→    } finally {
   270→      setSavingField(null);
   271→    }
   272→  }, [onSaveFieldAsDefault, onChange]);
   273→
   274→  // Drag and drop handlers for video upload
   275→  const handleDragOver = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
   276→    e.preventDefault();
   277→    e.stopPropagation();
   278→  }, []);
   279→
   280→  const handleDragEnter = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
   281→    e.preventDefault();
   282→    e.stopPropagation();
   283→    // Check if dragging files (not text or other content)
   284→    if (e.dataTransfer.types.includes('Files')) {
   285→      setIsDraggingVideo(true);
   286→    }
   287→  }, []);
   288→
   289→  const handleDragLeave = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
   290→    e.preventDefault();
   291→    e.stopPropagation();
   292→    // Only set to false if leaving the drop zone (not entering a child)
   293→    if (e.currentTarget === e.target || !e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node)) {
   294→      setIsDraggingVideo(false);
   295→    }
   296→  }, []);
   297→
   298→  const handleDrop = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
   299→    e.preventDefault();
   300→    e.stopPropagation();
   301→    setIsDraggingVideo(false);
   302→
   303→    const files = e.dataTransfer.files;
   304→    if (files.length > 0) {
   305→      const file = files[0];
   306→      // Check if it's a video file
   307→      if (file.type.startsWith('video/')) {
   308→        // Trigger the file select handler with a synthetic event
   309→        videoUpload.handleFileSelect({ target: { files } } as unknown as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>);
   310→      }
   311→    }
   312→  }, [videoUpload]);
   313→
   314→  // ==========================================================================
   315→  // RENDER
   316→  // ==========================================================================
   317→
   318→  return (
   319→    <div className="space-y-4">
   320→      {/* Header */}
   321→      {showHeader && (
   322→        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
   323→          <h3 className="text-lg font-medium flex items-center gap-2">
   324→            <RotateCcw className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
   325→            {headerTitle}
   326→          </h3>
   327→        </div>
   328→      )}
   329→
   330→      {/* Input Images with Frames Slider */}
   331→      {(startImageUrl || endImageUrl) && (
   332→        <div className="@container overflow-hidden">
   333→          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 @[280px]:grid-cols-3">
   334→            {/* Start Image */}
   335→            <div className="relative aspect-video">
   336→              {startImageUrl && (
   337→                <button
   338→                  type="button"
   339→                  onClick={() => startImageShotGenerationId && onNavigateToImage?.(startImageShotGenerationId)}
   340→                  disabled={!onNavigateToImage || !startImageShotGenerationId}
   341→                  className="w-full h-full relative bg-muted/30 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border/50 transition-all hover:ring-2 hover:ring-primary/50 hover:scale-[1.02] disabled:hover:ring-0 disabled:hover:scale-100 disabled:cursor-default"
   342→                  title={onNavigateToImage && startImageShotGenerationId ? "View start image" : undefined}
   343→                >
   344→                  <img
   345→                    src={startImageUrl}
   346→                    alt="Start frame"
   347→                    className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover"
   348→                  />
   349→                  <span className="absolute bottom-0.5 left-0.5 text-[10px] bg-black/60 text-white px-1 rounded">Start</span>
   350→                </button>
   351→              )}
   352→            </div>
   353→
   354→            {/* Frames Slider */}
   355→            <div className="order-last col-span-2 @[280px]:order-none @[280px]:col-span-1 flex items-center gap-2">
   356→              <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-center space-y-1">
   357→                <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center">
   358→                  <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Frames</Label>
   359→                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
   360→                    {settings.numFrames} ({framesToSeconds(settings.numFrames)})
   361→                  </span>
   362→                </div>
   363→                <Slider
   364→                  value={quantizeFrameCount(settings.numFrames, 9)}
   365→                  onValueChange={(value) => handleFrameCountChange(value)}
   366→                  min={9}
   367→                  max={maxFrames}
   368→                  step={4}
   369→                  className="w-full"
   370→                />
   371→              </div>
   372→            </div>
   373→
   374→            {/* End Image */}
   375→            <div className="relative aspect-video">
   376→              {endImageUrl && (
   377→                <button
   378→                  type="button"
   379→                  onClick={() => endImageShotGenerationId && onNavigateToImage?.(endImageShotGenerationId)}
   380→                  disabled={!onNavigateToImage || !endImageShotGenerationId}
   381→                  className="w-full h-full relative bg-muted/30 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border/50 transition-all hover:ring-2 hover:ring-primary/50 hover:scale-[1.02] disabled:hover:ring-0 disabled:hover:scale-100 disabled:cursor-default"
   382→                  title={onNavigateToImage && endImageShotGenerationId ? "View end image" : undefined}
   383→                >
   384→                  <img
   385→                    src={endImageUrl}
   386→                    alt="End frame"
   387→                    className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover"
   388→                  />
   389→                  <span className="absolute bottom-0.5 right-0.5 text-[10px] bg-black/60 text-white px-1 rounded">End</span>
   390→                </button>
   391→              )}
   392→            </div>
   393→          </div>
   394→        </div>
   395→      )}
   396→
   397→      {/* Prompt */}
   398→      <div className="space-y-2">
   399→        <div className="space-y-1">
   400→          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
   401→            <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Prompt:</Label>
   402→            {promptField.badgeType === 'enhanced' && (
   403→              <EnhancedPromptBadge
   404→                onClear={promptField.handleClearEnhanced}
   405→                onSetAsDefault={onSaveFieldAsDefault ? () => handleSaveFieldAsDefault('prompt', promptField.displayValue) : undefined}
   406→                isSaving={savingField === 'prompt'}
   407→                basePrompt={basePromptForEnhancement}
   408→              />
   409→            )}
   410→            {promptField.badgeType === 'default' && (
   411→              <span className="text-[10px] bg-primary/15 text-primary px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
   412→                Default
   413→              </span>
   414→            )}
   415→            {promptField.badgeType === null && promptField.userHasSetPrompt && (
   416→              <FieldDefaultControls
   417→                isUsingDefault={false}
   418→                onUseDefault={promptField.handleClearAll}
   419→                onSetAsDefault={onSaveFieldAsDefault ? () => handleSaveFieldAsDefault('prompt', promptField.displayValue) : undefined}
   420→                isSaving={savingField === 'prompt'}
   421→              />
   422→            )}
   423→          </div>
   424→          <Textarea
   425→            value={promptField.displayValue}
   426→            onChange={(e) => promptField.handleChange(e.target.value)}
   427→            className="h-20 text-sm resize-none"
   428→            placeholder="Describe this segment..."
   429→            clearable
   430→            onClear={promptField.handleClearAll}
   431→            voiceInput
   432→            voiceContext="This is a prompt for a video segment. Describe the motion, action, or visual content you want in this part of the video."
   433→            onVoiceResult={promptField.handleVoiceResult}
   434→          />
   435→        </div>
   436→
   437→        {/* Enhance Prompt Toggle & Make Primary Variant */}
   438→        <div className="flex gap-2">
   439→          {onEnhancePromptChange && (
   440→            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 p-2 bg-muted/30 rounded-lg border flex-1">
   441→              <Switch
   442→                id="enhance-prompt-segment"
   443→                checked={enhancePromptEnabled ?? false}
   444→                onCheckedChange={onEnhancePromptChange}
   445→              />
   446→              <Label htmlFor="enhance-prompt-segment" className="text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer flex-1">
   447→                Enhance Prompt
   448→              </Label>
   449→            </div>
   450→          )}
   451→          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 p-2 bg-muted/30 rounded-lg border flex-1">
   452→            <Switch
   453→              id="make-primary-segment"
   454→              checked={isRegeneration ? settings.makePrimaryVariant : true}
   455→              onCheckedChange={isRegeneration ? (value) => onChange({ makePrimaryVariant: value }) : undefined}
   456→              disabled={!isRegeneration}
   457→            />
   458→            <Label htmlFor="make-primary-segment" className="text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer flex-1">
   459→              Make Primary
   460→            </Label>
   461→          </div>
   462→        </div>
   463→      </div>
   464→
   465→      {/* Advanced Settings */}
   466→      <Collapsible open={showAdvanced} onOpenChange={setShowAdvanced}>
   467→        <CollapsibleTrigger asChild>
   468→          <Button
   469→            variant="ghost"
   470→            size="sm"
   471→            className={`w-full justify-between h-9 text-xs font-medium ${
   472→              showAdvanced
   473→                ? 'bg-muted text-foreground hover:bg-muted rounded-b-none'
   474→                : 'bg-primary/10 text-primary hover:bg-primary/20 hover:text-primary'
   475→            }`}
   476→          >
   477→            <span>Advanced Settings</span>
   478→            <ChevronLeft className={`w-3 h-3 transition-transform ${showAdvanced ? '-rotate-90' : ''}`} />
   479→          </Button>
   480→        </CollapsibleTrigger>
   481→        <CollapsibleContent className={edgeExtendAmount === 6 ? '-mx-6' : '-mx-4'}>
   482→          <div className={`space-y-3 bg-muted/30 border-y border-border/50 ${edgeExtendAmount === 6 ? 'px-6 py-3' : 'px-4 py-3'}`}>
   483→            {/* Before/After Each Prompt */}
   484→            {(shotDefaults?.textBeforePrompts !== undefined || shotDefaults?.textAfterPrompts !== undefined) && (
   485→              <div className="space-y-2">
   486→                <DefaultableTextarea
   487→                  label="Before:"
   488→                  value={settings.textBeforePrompts}
   489→                  defaultValue={shotDefaults?.textBeforePrompts}
   490→                  hasDbOverride={hasOverride?.textBeforePrompts}
   491→                  onChange={(value) => onChange({ textBeforePrompts: value })}
   492→                  onClear={() => onChange({ textBeforePrompts: '' })}
   493→                  onUseDefault={() => onChange({ textBeforePrompts: undefined })}
   494→                  onSetAsDefault={onSaveFieldAsDefault ? (displayValue) => handleSaveFieldAsDefault('textBeforePrompts', displayValue) : undefined}
   495→                  isSavingDefault={savingField === 'textBeforePrompts'}
   496→                  className="min-h-0 h-8 text-xs resize-none py-1.5 overflow-hidden"
   497→                  placeholder="Text to prepend..."
   498→                  voiceInput
   499→                  voiceContext="This is text to prepend before video prompts. Keep it brief - style keywords, quality tags, or consistent elements."
   500→                  onVoiceResult={(result) => {
   501→                    onChange({ textBeforePrompts: result.prompt || result.transcription });
   502→                  }}
   503→                />
   504→                <DefaultableTextarea
   505→                  label="After:"
   506→                  value={settings.textAfterPrompts}
   507→                  defaultValue={shotDefaults?.textAfterPrompts}
   508→                  hasDbOverride={hasOverride?.textAfterPrompts}
   509→                  onChange={(value) => onChange({ textAfterPrompts: value })}
   510→                  onClear={() => onChange({ textAfterPrompts: '' })}
   511→                  onUseDefault={() => onChange({ textAfterPrompts: undefined })}
   512→                  onSetAsDefault={onSaveFieldAsDefault ? (displayValue) => handleSaveFieldAsDefault('textAfterPrompts', displayValue) : undefined}
   513→                  isSavingDefault={savingField === 'textAfterPrompts'}
   514→                  className="min-h-0 h-8 text-xs resize-none py-1.5 overflow-hidden"
   515→                  placeholder="Text to append..."
   516→                  voiceInput
   517→                  voiceContext="This is text to append after video prompts. Keep it brief - style keywords, quality tags, or consistent elements."
   518→                  onVoiceResult={(result) => {
   519→                    onChange({ textAfterPrompts: result.prompt || result.transcription });
   520→                  }}
   521→                />
   522→              </div>
   523→            )}
   524→
   525→            {/* Negative Prompt */}
   526→            <DefaultableTextarea
   527→              label="Negative Prompt:"
   528→              value={settings.negativePrompt}
   529→              defaultValue={shotDefaults?.negativePrompt}
   530→              hasDbOverride={hasOverride?.negativePrompt}
   531→              onChange={(value) => onChange({ negativePrompt: value })}
   532→              onClear={() => onChange({ negativePrompt: '' })}
   533→              onUseDefault={() => onChange({ negativePrompt: undefined })}
   534→              onSetAsDefault={onSaveFieldAsDefault ? (displayValue) => handleSaveFieldAsDefault('negativePrompt', displayValue) : undefined}
   535→              isSavingDefault={savingField === 'negativePrompt'}
   536→              className="h-16 text-xs resize-none"
   537→              placeholder="Things to avoid..."
   538→              voiceInput
   539→              voiceContext="This is a negative prompt - things to AVOID in video generation. List unwanted qualities as a comma-separated list."
   540→              onVoiceResult={(result) => {
   541→                onChange({ negativePrompt: result.prompt || result.transcription });
   542→              }}
   543→              containerClassName="space-y-1.5"
   544→            />
   545→
   546→            {/* Motion Controls */}
   547→            {(() => {
   548→              const isUsingMotionModeDefault = settings.motionMode === undefined && !!shotDefaults?.motionMode;
   549→              const isUsingPhaseConfigDefault = settings.phaseConfig === undefined && !!shotDefaults?.phaseConfig;
   550→              const isUsingLorasDefault = settings.loras === undefined && (shotDefaults?.loras?.length ?? 0) > 0;
   551→              const isUsingMotionDefaults = isUsingMotionModeDefault && isUsingPhaseConfigDefault;
   552→
   553→              return (
   554→                <MotionPresetSelector
   555→                  builtinPreset={builtinPreset}
   556→                  featuredPresetIds={featuredPresetIds}
   557→                  generationTypeMode={generationMode}
   558→                  selectedPhasePresetId={settings.selectedPhasePresetId ?? shotDefaults?.selectedPhasePresetId ?? null}
   559→                  phaseConfig={settings.phaseConfig ?? shotDefaults?.phaseConfig ?? builtinPreset.metadata.phaseConfig}
   560→                  motionMode={settings.motionMode ?? shotDefaults?.motionMode ?? 'basic'}
   561→                  onPresetSelect={handlePhasePresetSelect}
   562→                  onPresetRemove={handlePhasePresetRemove}
   563→                  onModeChange={handleMotionModeChange}
   564→                  onPhaseConfigChange={handlePhaseConfigChange}
   565→                  availableLoras={availableLoras}
   566→                  randomSeed={settings.randomSeed}
   567→                  onRandomSeedChange={handleRandomSeedChange}
   568→                  queryKeyPrefix={queryKeyPrefix}
   569→                  labelSuffix={
   570→                    <FieldDefaultControls
   571→                      isUsingDefault={isUsingMotionDefaults}
   572→                      onUseDefault={() => onChange({ motionMode: undefined, phaseConfig: undefined, selectedPhasePresetId: undefined })}
   573→                      onSetAsDefault={onSaveFieldAsDefault ? async () => {
   574→                        await handleSaveFieldAsDefault('motionMode', settings.motionMode ?? shotDefaults?.motionMode ?? 'basic');
   575→                        await handleSaveFieldAsDefault('phaseConfig', settings.phaseConfig ?? shotDefaults?.phaseConfig);
   576→                        await handleSaveFieldAsDefault('selectedPhasePresetId', settings.selectedPhasePresetId ?? shotDefaults?.selectedPhasePresetId ?? null);
   577→                      } : undefined}
   578→                      isSaving={savingField === 'motionMode' || savingField === 'phaseConfig' || savingField === 'selectedPhasePresetId'}
   579→                    />
   580→                  }
   581→                  renderBasicModeContent={() => (
   582→                    <div className="space-y-3">
   583→                      <div className="relative">
   584→                        <ActiveLoRAsDisplay
   585→                          selectedLoras={effectiveLoras}
   586→                          onRemoveLora={handleRemoveLora}
   587→                          onLoraStrengthChange={handleLoraStrengthChange}
   588→                          availableLoras={availableLoras}
   589→                        />
   590→                        <div className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 z-10">
   591→                          <FieldDefaultControls
   592→                            isUsingDefault={isUsingLorasDefault}
   593→                            onUseDefault={() => onChange({
   594→                              loras: undefined,
   595→                              motionMode: undefined,
   596→                              phaseConfig: undefined,
   597→                              selectedPhasePresetId: undefined,
   598→                            })}
   599→                            onSetAsDefault={onSaveFieldAsDefault ? async () => {
   600→                              await handleSaveFieldAsDefault('loras', effectiveLoras);
   601→                              await handleSaveFieldAsDefault('motionMode', 'basic');
   602→                            } : undefined}
   603→                            isSaving={savingField === 'loras' || savingField === 'motionMode'}
   604→                          />
   605→                        </div>
   606→                      </div>
   607→                      <button
   608→                        onClick={handleAddLoraClick}
   609→                        className="w-full text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground border border-dashed border-muted-foreground/30 hover:border-muted-foreground/50 rounded-lg py-2 transition-colors"
   610→                      >
   611→                        Add or manage LoRAs
   612→                      </button>
   613→                    </div>
   614→                  )}
   615→                />
   616→              );
   617→            })()}
   618→
   619→            {/* Structure Video Section */}
   620→            {/* Timeline Mode: Loading state when uploading or waiting for props (no existing video) */}
   621→            {isTimelineMode && videoUpload.isVideoLoading && !structureVideoType && (
   622→              <div className="space-y-3 pt-3 border-t border-border/50">
   623→                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
   624→                  <Video className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
   625→                  <span>Structure Video</span>
   626→                  <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin text-primary" />
   627→                </div>
   628→                <VideoPreviewSkeleton message="Loading video..." />
   629→              </div>
   630→            )}
   631→
   632→            {/* Timeline Mode: Add Structure Video (when no video exists and not loading) */}
   633→            {isTimelineMode && !structureVideoType && !videoUpload.isVideoLoading && onAddSegmentStructureVideo && (
   634→              <div
   635→                className="relative space-y-3 pt-3 border-t border-border/50"
   636→                onDragOver={handleDragOver}
   637→                onDragEnter={handleDragEnter}
   638→                onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
   639→                onDrop={handleDrop}
   640→              >
   641→                {/* Drop overlay - extends slightly beyond form edges */}
   642→                {isDraggingVideo && (
   643→                  <div
   644→                    className="absolute z-20 flex items-center justify-center bg-primary/10 rounded-lg ring-2 ring-primary ring-dashed"
   645→                    style={{
   646→                      top: '-4px',
   647→                      bottom: '-4px',
   648→                      left: '-8px',
   649→                      right: '-8px',
   650→                    }}
   651→                  >
   652→                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-primary font-medium">
   653→                      <Video className="w-4 h-4" />
   654→                      Drop video here
   655→                    </div>
   656→                  </div>
   657→                )}
   658→                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
   659→                  <Video className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
   660→                  <span>Structure Video</span>
   661→                </div>
   662→                <div className="space-y-2">
   663→                  <input
   664→                    ref={videoUpload.addFileInputRef}
   665→                    type="file"
   666→                    accept="video/mp4,video/webm,video/quicktime"
   667→                    onChange={videoUpload.handleFileSelect}
   668→                    disabled={videoUpload.isUploadingVideo}
   669→                    className="hidden"
   670→                    id="segment-structure-video-upload"
   671→                  />
   672→                  <div className="flex gap-2">
   673→                    <Label htmlFor="segment-structure-video-upload" className="m-0 cursor-pointer flex-1">
   674→                      <Button
   675→                        variant="outline"
   676→                        size="sm"
   677→                        disabled={videoUpload.isUploadingVideo}
   678→                        className="w-full"
   679→                        asChild
   680→                      >
   681→                        <span>
   682→                          {videoUpload.isUploadingVideo ? (
   683→                            <>
   684→                              <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 mr-2 animate-spin" />
   685→                              {Math.round(videoUpload.uploadProgress)}%
   686→                            </>
   687→                          ) : (
   688→                            <>
   689→                              <Video className="w-3 h-3 mr-2" />
   690→                              Upload
   691→                            </>
   692→                          )}
   693→                        </span>
   694→                      </Button>
   695→                    </Label>
   696→                    <Button
   697→                      variant="outline"
   698→                      size="sm"
   699→                      disabled={videoUpload.isUploadingVideo}
   700→                      onClick={() => videoUpload.setShowVideoBrowser(true)}
   701→                      className="flex-1"
   702→                    >
   703→                      <Images className="w-3 h-3 mr-2" />
   704→                      Browse
   705→                    </Button>
   706→                  </div>
   707→                  <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
   708→                    Drop a video here or click to upload
   709→                  </p>
   710→                </div>
   711→              </div>
   712→            )}
   713→
   714→            {/* Structure Video Overrides - shown when segment has structure video */}
   715→            {structureVideoType && (
   716→              <div
   717→                className="space-y-3 pt-3 border-t border-border/50"
   718→                onDragOver={isTimelineMode ? handleDragOver : undefined}
   719→                onDragEnter={isTimelineMode ? handleDragEnter : undefined}
   720→                onDragLeave={isTimelineMode ? handleDragLeave : undefined}
   721→                onDrop={isTimelineMode ? handleDrop : undefined}
   722→              >
   723→                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
   724→                  <Video className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
   725→                  <span>Structure Video {isTimelineMode ? '' : 'Overrides'}</span>
   726→                  <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-muted text-muted-foreground/80">
   727→                    {structureVideoType === 'uni3c' ? 'Uni3C' : structureVideoType === 'flow' ? 'Optical Flow' : structureVideoType === 'canny' ? 'Canny' : structureVideoType === 'depth' ? 'Depth' : structureVideoType}
   728→                  </span>
   729→                </div>
   730→
   731→                {/* 3-Frame Preview with Remove button overlay */}
   732→                {structureVideoUrl && structureVideoFrameRange && (
   733→                  <div className="relative">
   734→                    {/* Drop overlay when dragging - extends slightly beyond preview */}
   735→                    {isDraggingVideo && isTimelineMode && (
   736→                      <div
   737→                        className="absolute z-20 flex items-center justify-center bg-primary/20 rounded-lg border-2 border-dashed border-primary"
   738→                        style={{
   739→                          top: '-4px',
   740→                          bottom: '-4px',
   741→                          left: '-8px',
   742→                          right: '-8px',
   743→                        }}
   744→                      >
   745→                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-primary font-medium">
   746→                          <Video className="w-4 h-4" />
   747→                          Drop to replace
   748→                        </div>
   749→                      </div>
   750→                    )}
   751→                    {/* Remove button - show even while preview is loading, just not during upload */}
   752→                    {isTimelineMode && onRemoveSegmentStructureVideo && !videoUpload.isUploadingVideo && !isDraggingVideo && (
   753→                      <Button
   754→                        variant="ghost"
   755→                        size="sm"
   756→                        onClick={(e) => {
   757→                          e.stopPropagation();
   758→                          videoUpload.clearPendingVideo();
   759→                          onRemoveSegmentStructureVideo();

1→/**
     2→ * DefaultableTextarea Component
     3→ *
     4→ * A textarea that can display a default value with a badge when no local value is set.
     5→ * Handles the common pattern of showing shot-level defaults with visual indication.
     6→ *
     7→ * Semantics:
     8→ * - `value === undefined` = show default value with badge
     9→ * - `value === ''` = show empty (user explicitly cleared, no badge)
    10→ * - `value === 'text'` = show user's value (no badge)
    11→ */
    12→
    13→import React from 'react';
    14→import { Textarea, TextareaProps } from '@/shared/components/ui/textarea';
    15→import { Label } from '@/shared/components/ui/label';
    16→import { RotateCcw, Save, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
    17→import { getDefaultableField } from './segmentSettingsUtils';
    18→
    19→type BadgeType = 'default' | 'enhanced' | null;
    20→
    21→interface DefaultableTextareaProps extends Omit<TextareaProps, 'value' | 'onChange'> {
    22→  /** Label text for the field */
    23→  label: string;
    24→  /** Current value (undefined = use default, '' = explicitly empty, string = user value) */
    25→  value: string | undefined;
    26→  /** Default value to show when value is undefined */
    27→  defaultValue?: string;
    28→  /** Whether there's a saved override in the database */
    29→  hasDbOverride?: boolean;
    30→  /** Callback when value changes */
    31→  onChange: (value: string) => void;
    32→  /** Callback when field is cleared */
    33→  onClear?: () => void;
    34→  /** Badge type to show (overrides automatic detection) */
    35→  badgeType?: BadgeType;
    36→  /** Custom badge label */
    37→  badgeLabel?: string;
    38→  /** Label size variant */
    39→  labelSize?: 'xs' | 'sm';
    40→  /** Additional class for the container */
    41→  containerClassName?: string;
    42→  /** Callback to use shot default value */
    43→  onUseDefault?: () => void;
    44→  /**
    45→   * Callback to set current value as shot default.
    46→   * Receives the actual displayed value (what the user sees in the field).
    47→   */
    48→  onSetAsDefault?: (displayValue: string) => void;
    49→  /** Whether currently saving as default */
    50→  isSavingDefault?: boolean;
    51→}
    52→
    53→/**
    54→ * Badge component for showing field state, or action buttons when overridden
    55→ */
    56→const FieldBadge: React.FC<{
    57→  type: BadgeType;
    58→  label?: string;
    59→  onUseDefault?: () => void;
    60→  onSetAsDefault?: (displayValue: string) => void;
    61→  isSaving?: boolean;
    62→  displayValue?: string;
    63→}> = ({ type, label, onUseDefault, onSetAsDefault, isSaving, displayValue }) => {
    64→  // If using default, show badge
    65→  if (type) {
    66→    const styles = {
    67→      default: 'bg-primary/15 text-primary',
    68→      enhanced: 'bg-green-500/15 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400',
    69→    };
    70→
    71→    const labels = {
    72→      default: 'Default',
    73→      enhanced: 'Enhanced',
    74→    };
    75→
    76→    return (
    77→      <span className={`text-[10px] ${styles[type]} px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded`}>
    78→        {label || labels[type]}
    79→      </span>
    80→    );
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  // If not using default, show action buttons (if callbacks provided)
    84→  if (!onUseDefault && !onSetAsDefault) return null;
    85→
    86→  return (
    87→    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
    88→      {onUseDefault && (
    89→        <button
    90→          type="button"
    91→          onClick={onUseDefault}
    92→          disabled={isSaving}
    93→          className="text-[10px] bg-muted hover:bg-muted/80 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded flex items-center gap-0.5 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
    94→          title="Use the shot default value"
    95→        >
    96→          <RotateCcw className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
    97→          Use Default
    98→        </button>
    99→      )}
   100→      {onSetAsDefault && (
   101→        <button
   102→          type="button"
   103→          onClick={() => onSetAsDefault(displayValue ?? '')}
   104→          disabled={isSaving}
   105→          className="text-[10px] bg-muted hover:bg-primary/15 text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded flex items-center gap-0.5 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
   106→          title="Set this value as the shot default"
   107→        >
   108→          {isSaving ? (
   109→            <Loader2 className="w-2.5 h-2.5 animate-spin" />
   110→          ) : (
   111→            <Save className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
   112→          )}
   113→          Set as Default
   114→        </button>
   115→      )}
   116→    </div>
   117→  );
   118→};
   119→
   120→export const DefaultableTextarea: React.FC<DefaultableTextareaProps> = ({
   121→  label,
   122→  value,
   123→  defaultValue,
   124→  hasDbOverride,
   125→  onChange,
   126→  onClear,
   127→  badgeType: explicitBadgeType,
   128→  badgeLabel,
   129→  labelSize = 'xs',
   130→  containerClassName,
   131→  clearable = true,
   132→  onUseDefault,
   133→  onSetAsDefault,
   134→  isSavingDefault,
   135→  ...textareaProps
   136→}) => {
   137→  // Compute display state using the helper
   138→  const { isUsingDefault, displayValue } = getDefaultableField(
   139→    value,
   140→    defaultValue,
   141→    hasDbOverride
   142→  );
   143→
   144→  // Determine badge type: explicit override > automatic detection
   145→  const badgeType: BadgeType = explicitBadgeType !== undefined
   146→    ? explicitBadgeType
   147→    : (isUsingDefault ? 'default' : null);
   148→
   149→  const labelSizeClass = labelSize === 'xs' ? 'text-xs' : 'text-sm';
   150→
   151→  return (
   152→    <div className={containerClassName}>
   153→      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
   154→        <Label className={`${labelSizeClass} font-medium`}>{label}</Label>
   155→        <FieldBadge
   156→          type={badgeType}
   157→          label={badgeLabel}
   158→          onUseDefault={onUseDefault}
   159→          onSetAsDefault={onSetAsDefault}
   160→          isSaving={isSavingDefault}
   161→          displayValue={displayValue}
   162→        />
   163→      </div>
   164→      <Textarea
   165→        value={displayValue}
   166→        onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
   167→        clearable={clearable}
   168→        onClear={onClear}
   169→        {...textareaProps}
   170→      />
   171→    </div>
   172→  );
   173→};

    27→const Textarea = React.forwardRef<HTMLTextAreaElement, TextareaProps>(

<summary>
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user is fixing persistent iOS Safari overlay shifting issues in a fullscreen lightbox component on iPad. The core problem: interacting with the lightbox (especially video lightboxes with form inputs) can cause the visual viewport to shift, leaving "dead space at the bottom" that persists across subsequent lightbox opens. The user wants a robust solution that works with iOS Safari's viewport management rather than fighting it.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **iOS Safari visual viewport vs layout viewport**: The on-screen keyboard shifts the visual viewport independently of `window.scrollY`. `position: fixed` elements anchor to the layout viewport.
   - **`touch-action` ancestor intersection rule**: `touch-action` values are intersected across ALL ancestors, not overridden by children. `none ∩ pan-y = none`. This means `touch-action: none` on a parent kills scrolling in all descendants — must use **sibling isolation** pattern.
   - **`overflow: hidden` on `<html>` vs `<body>`**: `overflow: hidden` on `<html>` blocks iOS Safari's visual viewport restoration after keyboard dismiss, causing persistent offset. Putting it on `<body>` only appears to work — body content can't scroll, but iOS can still manage the viewport via the html element.
   - **`overscroll-behavior: contain` vs `none`**: `contain` prevents scroll chaining but allows the element's own rubber-band bounce. `none` prevents both. Neither works on elements that aren't actual scroll containers (no overflow content).
   - **iOS Safari auto-zoom**: Inputs with `font-size < 16px` trigger auto-zoom on focus, shifting the visual viewport. This is a major trigger for the persistent viewport offset issue.
   - **`window.visualViewport`**: Separate from `window.scrollY`. Visual viewport can shift without triggering `scroll` events on `window`. Our scroll listener has zero visibility into visual viewport shifts.
   - **WebKit bug #153852**: `overflow: hidden` alone doesn't reliably prevent body scrolling on iOS Safari.
   - **`react-remove-scroll`**: Present in dep tree via `cmdk` → `@radix-ui/react-dialog`, but NOT used by Base UI's Dialog (which the lightbox uses). TasksPane has `data-scroll-lock-scrollable` attributes for it.

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - **`src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/components/LightboxShell.tsx`** (MOST CRITICAL)
     - Contains all scroll lock logic for the lightbox
     - Multiple iterations: position:fixed → CSS class overflow:hidden → CSS without overflow:hidden → overflow:hidden on body only → inline style overflow:hidden on html with focus/blur toggle
     - Current state of scroll lock effect:
     ```tsx
     const isActuallyModal = isMobile && !isTabletOrLarger;
     useEffect(() => {
       if (isActuallyModal) return;
       const savedScrollY = window.scrollY;
       const html = document.documentElement;
       html.classList.add('lightbox-open');
       html.style.overflow = 'hidden';

       // Temporarily lift overflow:hidden when inputs are focused so iOS Safari
       // can manage the visual viewport for the on-screen keyboard.
       const handleFocusIn = (e: FocusEvent) => {
         const tag = (e.target as HTMLElement)?.tagName;
         if (tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA') {
           html.style.overflow = '';
         }
       };
       const handleFocusOut = () => {
         setTimeout(() => {
           if (html.classList.contains('lightbox-open')) {
             html.style.overflow = 'hidden';
           }
         }, 300);
       };
       document.addEventListener('focusin', handleFocusIn);
       document.addEventListener('focusout', handleFocusOut);

       const lockScroll = () => window.scrollTo(0, savedScrollY);
       window.addEventListener('scroll', lockScroll);

       return () => {
         window.removeEventListener('scroll', lockScroll);
         document.removeEventListener('focusin', handleFocusIn);
         document.removeEventListener('focusout', handleFocusOut);
         if (document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement) {
           document.activeElement.blur();
         }
         html.style.overflow = '';
         html.classList.remove('lightbox-open');
         window.scrollTo(0, savedScrollY);
       };
     }, [isActuallyModal]);
     ```
     - Backdrop overlay has `touchAction: 'none'` in inline style
     - Popup has NO `touch-action` (neutral — can't add it due to intersection rule killing panel scroll)

   - **`src/index.css`** (lines ~319-345)
     - Lightbox scroll lock CSS class and iOS auto-zoom prevention
     - Current state:
     ```css
     html.lightbox-open {
       overscroll-behavior: none;
     }
     html.lightbox-open body {
       overflow: hidden;
       overscroll-behavior: none;
     }

     /* Prevent iOS Safari auto-zoom on input focus. */
     @media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse) {
       input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"] {
         font-size: 16px !important;
       }
     }
     ```

   - **`src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/components/layouts/LightboxLayout.tsx`**
     - Panel layout media section: both desktop and stacked now use `touch-none`
     - Centered layout outer container: added `touch-none`
     - Centered layout media container: changed from `touch-pan-y` to `touch-none`
     - Panel container: changed from `overscroll-contain` to `overscroll-none`
     - Key touch-action coverage (sibling isolation pattern):
       - Panel layout: neutral parent → media section (`touch-none`) + controls panel (`overscroll-none`)
       - Centered layout: outer `touch-none` (no scrollable children)

   - **`src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/components/SegmentSlotFormView.tsx`**

   - **`src/shared/hooks/use-mobile.tsx`**
     - `isMobile` returns `true` on iPad (due to `coarsePointer` or `isIpadOsLike`)
     - `isTabletOrLarger` from `useDeviceDetection` is `true` when width >= 768px

   - **`index.html`**

4. Errors and fixes:
   - **`overflow: hidden` on html blocks iOS viewport restoration**: Removing it from html and keeping only on body fixed the persistent "dead space" from keyboard interactions. User confirmed "BEAUTIFUL!"
   - **`overscroll-behavior: contain/none` doesn't work on non-scroll-containers**: When content doesn't overflow, the element isn't a scroll container, so `overscroll-behavior` doesn't apply and gestures pass through to body. Fixed by adding `overflow: hidden` on body.
   - **`touch-action: none` on parent kills child scrolling (intersection rule)**: Initially put `touch-none` on SegmentSlotFormView outer div, which would have killed form scrolling. Fixed by using sibling isolation: `touch-none` on backdrop only, neutral parent, `touch-auto` on form.
   - **`touch-pan-y` on media sections allowed viewport rubber-banding**: Changed to `touch-none` on all media sections (stacked layout and centered layout).

   511→                  onUseDefault={() => onChange({ textAfterPrompts: undefined })}
   512→                  onSetAsDefault={onSaveFieldAsDefault ? (displayValue) => handleSaveFieldAsDefault('textAfterPrompts', displayValue) : undefined}
   513→                  isSavingDefault={savingField === 'textAfterPrompts'}
   514→                  className="min-h-0 h-8 text-xs resize-none py-1.5 overflow-hidden"
   515→                  placeholder="Text to append..."
   516→                  voiceInput
   517→                  voiceContext="This is text to append after video prompts. Keep it brief - style keywords, quality tags, or consistent elements."
   518→                  onVoiceResult={(result) => {
   519→                    onChange({ textAfterPrompts: result.prompt || result.transcription });
   520→                  }}
   521→                />
   522→              </div>
   523→            )}
   524→
   525→            {/* Negative Prompt */}
   526→            <DefaultableTextarea
   527→              label="Negative Prompt:"
   528→              value={settings.negativePrompt}
   529→              defaultValue={shotDefaults?.negativePrompt}
   530→              hasDbOverride={hasOverride?.negativePrompt}
   531→              onChange={(value) => onChange({ negativePrompt: value })}
   532→              onClear={() => onChange({ negativePrompt: '' })}
   533→              onUseDefault={() => onChange({ negativePrompt: undefined })}
   534→              onSetAsDefault={onSaveFieldAsDefault ? (displayValue) => handleSaveFieldAsDefault('negativePrompt', displayValue) : undefined}
   535→              isSavingDefault={savingField === 'negativePrompt'}
   536→              className="h-16 text-xs resize-none"
   537→              placeholder="Things to avoid..."
   538→              voiceInput
   539→              voiceContext="This is a negative prompt - things to AVOID in video generation. List unwanted qualities as a comma-separated list."
   540→              onVoiceResult={(result) => {
   541→                onChange({ negativePrompt: result.prompt || result.transcription });
   542→              }}
   543→              containerClassName="space-y-1.5"
   544→            />
   545→
   546→            {/* Motion Controls */}
   547→            {(() => {
   548→              const isUsingMotionModeDefault = settings.motionMode === undefined && !!shotDefaults?.motionMode;
   549→              const isUsingPhaseConfigDefault = settings.phaseConfig === undefined && !!shotDefaults?.phaseConfig;
   550→              const isUsingLorasDefault = settings.loras === undefined && (shotDefaults?.loras?.length ?? 0) > 0;
   551→              const isUsingMotionDefaults = isUsingMotionModeDefault && isUsingPhaseConfigDefault;
   552→
   553→              return (
   554→                <MotionPresetSelector
   555→                  builtinPreset={builtinPreset}
   556→                  featuredPresetIds={featuredPresetIds}
   557→                  generationTypeMode={generationMode}
   558→                  selectedPhasePresetId={settings.selectedPhasePresetId ?? shotDefaults?.selectedPhasePresetId ?? null}
   559→                  phaseConfig={settings.phaseConfig ?? shotDefaults?.phaseConfig ?? builtinPreset.metadata.phaseConfig}
   560→                  motionMode={settings.motionMode ?? shotDefaults?.motionMode ?? 'basic'}
   561→                  onPresetSelect={handlePhasePresetSelect}
   562→                  onPresetRemove={handlePhasePresetRemove}
   563→                  onModeChange={handleMotionModeChange}
   564→                  onPhaseConfigChange={handlePhaseConfigChange}
   565→                  availableLoras={availableLoras}
   566→                  randomSeed={settings.randomSeed}
   567→                  onRandomSeedChange={handleRandomSeedChange}
   568→                  queryKeyPrefix={queryKeyPrefix}
   569→                  labelSuffix={
   570→                    <FieldDefaultControls
   571→                      isUsingDefault={isUsingMotionDefaults}
   572→                      onUseDefault={() => onChange({ motionMode: undefined, phaseConfig: undefined, selectedPhasePresetId: undefined })}
   573→                      onSetAsDefault={onSaveFieldAsDefault ? async () => {
   574→                        await handleSaveFieldAsDefault('motionMode', settings.motionMode ?? shotDefaults?.motionMode ?? 'basic');
   575→                        await handleSaveFieldAsDefault('phaseConfig', settings.phaseConfig ?? shotDefaults?.phaseConfig);
   576→                        await handleSaveFieldAsDefault('selectedPhasePresetId', settings.selectedPhasePresetId ?? shotDefaults?.selectedPhasePresetId ?? null);
   577→                      } : undefined}
   578→                      isSaving={savingField === 'motionMode' || savingField === 'phaseConfig' || savingField === 'selectedPhasePresetId'}
   579→                    />
   580→                  }
   581→                  renderBasicModeContent={() => (
   582→                    <div className="space-y-3">
   583→                      <div className="relative">
   584→                        <ActiveLoRAsDisplay
   585→                          selectedLoras={effectiveLoras}
   586→                          onRemoveLora={handleRemoveLora}
   587→                          onLoraStrengthChange={handleLoraStrengthChange}
   588→                          availableLoras={availableLoras}
   589→                        />
   590→                        <div className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 z-10">
   591→                          <FieldDefaultControls
   592→                            isUsingDefault={isUsingLorasDefault}
   593→                            onUseDefault={() => onChange({
   594→                              loras: undefined,
   595→                              motionMode: undefined,
   596→                              phaseConfig: undefined,
   597→                              selectedPhasePresetId: undefined,
   598→                            })}
   599→                            onSetAsDefault={onSaveFieldAsDefault ? async () => {
   600→                              await handleSaveFieldAsDefault('loras', effectiveLoras);
   601→                              await handleSaveFieldAsDefault('motionMode', 'basic');
   602→                            } : undefined}
   603→                            isSaving={savingField === 'loras' || savingField === 'motionMode'}
   604→                          />
   605→                        </div>
   606→                      </div>
   607→                      <button
   608→                        onClick={handleAddLoraClick}
   609→                        className="w-full text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground border border-dashed border-muted-foreground/30 hover:border-muted-foreground/50 rounded-lg py-2 transition-colors"
   610→                      >
   611→                        Add or manage LoRAs
   612→                      </button>
   613→                    </div>
   614→                  )}
   615→                />
   616→              );
   617→            })()}
   618→
   619→            {/* Structure Video Section */}
   620→            {/* Timeline Mode: Loading state when uploading or waiting for props (no existing video) */}
   621→            {isTimelineMode && videoUpload.isVideoLoading && !structureVideoType && (
   622→              <div className="space-y-3 pt-3 border-t border-border/50">
   623→                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
   624→                  <Video className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
   625→                  <span>Structure Video</span>
   626→                  <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin text-primary" />
   627→                </div>
   628→                <VideoPreviewSkeleton message="Loading video..." />
   629→              </div>
   630→            )}
   631→
   632→            {/* Timeline Mode: Add Structure Video (when no video exists and not loading) */}
   633→            {isTimelineMode && !structureVideoType && !videoUpload.isVideoLoading && onAddSegmentStructureVideo && (
   634→              <div
   635→                className="relative space-y-3 pt-3 border-t border-border/50"
   636→                onDragOver={handleDragOver}
   637→                onDragEnter={handleDragEnter}
   638→                onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
   639→                onDrop={handleDrop}
   640→              >
   641→                {/* Drop overlay - extends slightly beyond form edges */}
   642→                {isDraggingVideo && (
   643→                  <div
   644→                    className="absolute z-20 flex items-center justify-center bg-primary/10 rounded-lg ring-2 ring-primary ring-dashed"
   645→                    style={{
   646→                      top: '-4px',
   647→                      bottom: '-4px',
   648→                      left: '-8px',
   649→                      right: '-8px',
   650→                    }}
   651→                  >
   652→                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-primary font-medium">
   653→                      <Video className="w-4 h-4" />
   654→                      Drop video here
   655→                    </div>
   656→                  </div>
   657→                )}
   658→                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
   659→                  <Video className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
   660→                  <span>Structure Video</span>
   661→                </div>
   662→                <div className="space-y-2">
   663→                  <input
   664→                    ref={videoUpload.addFileInputRef}
   665→                    type="file"
   666→                    accept="video/mp4,video/webm,video/quicktime"
   667→                    onChange={videoUpload.handleFileSelect}
   668→                    disabled={videoUpload.isUploadingVideo}
   669→                    className="hidden"
   670→                    id="segment-structure-video-upload"
   671→                  />
   672→                  <div className="flex gap-2">
   673→                    <Label htmlFor="segment-structure-video-upload" className="m-0 cursor-pointer flex-1">
   674→                      <Button
   675→                        variant="outline"
   676→                        size="sm"
   677→                        disabled={videoUpload.isUploadingVideo}
   678→                        className="w-full"
   679→                        asChild
   680→                      >
   681→                        <span>
   682→                          {videoUpload.isUploadingVideo ? (
   683→                            <>
   684→                              <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 mr-2 animate-spin" />
   685→                              {Math.round(videoUpload.uploadProgress)}%
   686→                            </>
   687→                          ) : (
   688→                            <>
   689→                              <Video className="w-3 h-3 mr-2" />
   690→                              Upload
   691→                            </>
   692→                          )}
   693→                        </span>
   694→                      </Button>
   695→                    </Label>
   696→                    <Button
   697→                      variant="outline"
   698→                      size="sm"
   699→                      disabled={videoUpload.isUploadingVideo}
   700→                      onClick={() => videoUpload.setShowVideoBrowser(true)}
   701→                      className="flex-1"
   702→                    >
   703→                      <Images className="w-3 h-3 mr-2" />
   704→                      Browse
   705→                    </Button>
   706→                  </div>
   707→                  <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
   708→                    Drop a video here or click to upload
   709→                  </p>
   710→                </div>
   711→              </div>
   712→            )}
   713→
   714→            {/* Structure Video Overrides - shown when segment has structure video */}
   715→            {structureVideoType && (
   716→              <div
   717→                className="space-y-3 pt-3 border-t border-border/50"
   718→                onDragOver={isTimelineMode ? handleDragOver : undefined}
   719→                onDragEnter={isTimelineMode ? handleDragEnter : undefined}
   720→                onDragLeave={isTimelineMode ? handleDragLeave : undefined}
   721→                onDrop={isTimelineMode ? handleDrop : undefined}
   722→              >
   723→                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
   724→                  <Video className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
   725→                  <span>Structure Video {isTimelineMode ? '' : 'Overrides'}</span>
   726→                  <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-muted text-muted-foreground/80">
   727→                    {structureVideoType === 'uni3c' ? 'Uni3C' : structureVideoType === 'flow' ? 'Optical Flow' : structureVideoType === 'canny' ? 'Canny' : structureVideoType === 'depth' ? 'Depth' : structureVideoType}
   728→                  </span>
   729→                </div>
   730→
   731→                {/* 3-Frame Preview with Remove button overlay */}
   732→                {structureVideoUrl && structureVideoFrameRange && (
   733→                  <div className="relative">
   734→                    {/* Drop overlay when dragging - extends slightly beyond preview */}
   735→                    {isDraggingVideo && isTimelineMode && (
   736→                      <div
   737→                        className="absolute z-20 flex items-center justify-center bg-primary/20 rounded-lg border-2 border-dashed border-primary"
   738→                        style={{
   739→                          top: '-4px',
   740→                          bottom: '-4px',
   741→                          left: '-8px',
   742→                          right: '-8px',
   743→                        }}
   744→                      >
   745→                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-primary font-medium">
   746→                          <Video className="w-4 h-4" />
   747→                          Drop to replace
   748→                        </div>
   749→                      </div>
   750→                    )}
   751→                    {/* Remove button - show even while preview is loading, just not during upload */}
   752→                    {isTimelineMode && onRemoveSegmentStructureVideo && !videoUpload.isUploadingVideo && !isDraggingVideo && (
   753→                      <Button
   754→                        variant="ghost"
   755→                        size="sm"
   756→                        onClick={(e) => {
   757→                          e.stopPropagation();
   758→                          videoUpload.clearPendingVideo();
   759→                          onRemoveSegmentStructureVideo();
   760→                        }}
   761→                        onTouchEnd={(e) => {
   762→                          e.stopPropagation();
   763→                          e.preventDefault();
   764→                          videoUpload.clearPendingVideo();
   765→                          onRemoveSegmentStructureVideo();
   766→                        }}
   767→                        disabled={videoUpload.isUploadingVideo}
   768→                        className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 z-10 h-6 w-6 p-0 rounded-full bg-background/80 hover:bg-destructive/20 text-destructive hover:text-destructive"
   769→                        title="Remove video"
   770→                      >
   771→                        <X className="w-3 h-3" />
   772→                      </Button>
   773→                    )}
   774→                    {/* Show skeleton when waiting for new video props to arrive */}
   775→                    {videoUpload.pendingVideoUrl && videoUpload.pendingVideoUrl !== structureVideoUrl && !videoUpload.isUploadingVideo ? (
   776→                      <VideoPreviewSkeleton message="Loading new video..." />
   777→                    ) : (
   778→                      <StructureVideoPreview
   779→                        videoUrl={structureVideoUrl}
   780→                        frameRange={structureVideoFrameRange}
   781→                        treatment={settings.structureTreatment ?? structureVideoDefaults?.treatment ?? 'adjust'}
   782→                        onLoadComplete={videoUpload.handleVideoPreviewLoaded}
   783→                      />
   784→                    )}
   785→                  </div>
   786→                )}
   787→                {/* Skeleton when no preview URL yet but loading */}
   788→                {videoUpload.isVideoLoading && !structureVideoUrl && structureVideoFrameRange && (
   789→                  <VideoPreviewSkeleton message="Loading video..." />
   790→                )}
   791→
   792→                {/* Treatment Mode Selector with Upload/Browse - Timeline Mode Only */}
   793→                {isTimelineMode && (
   794→                  <div className="space-y-1.5">
   795→                    <div className="flex gap-2">
   796→                      <div className="flex-1">
   797→                        <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Treatment:</Label>
   798→                        <SegmentedControl
   799→                          value={settings.structureTreatment ?? structureVideoDefaults?.treatment ?? 'adjust'}
   800→                          onValueChange={(v) => onChange({ structureTreatment: v as 'adjust' | 'clip' })}
   801→                          className="w-full mt-1"
   802→                          size="sm"
   803→                        >
   804→                          <SegmentedControlItem
   805→                            value="adjust"
   806→                            className="flex-1"
   807→                            title="Stretch or compress video to match segment duration"
   808→                          >
   809→                            Fit to Range
   810→                          </SegmentedControlItem>
   811→                          <SegmentedControlItem
   812→                            value="clip"
   813→                            className="flex-1"
   814→                            title="Use video frames directly — extra frames are trimmed if video is longer"
   815→                          >
   816→                            1:1 Mapping
   817→                          </SegmentedControlItem>
   818→                        </SegmentedControl>
   819→                      </div>
   820→                      {/* Upload/Browse buttons */}
   821→                      {onAddSegmentStructureVideo && (
   822→                        <div className="flex-1 @container">
   823→                          <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Replace:</Label>
   824→                          <div className="flex gap-1 mt-1">
   825→                            <input
   826→                              ref={videoUpload.fileInputRef}
   827→                              type="file"
   828→                              accept="video/mp4,video/webm,video/quicktime"
   829→                              onChange={videoUpload.handleFileSelect}
   830→                              disabled={videoUpload.isUploadingVideo}
   831→                              className="hidden"
   832→                              id="segment-structure-video-replace"
   833→                            />
   834→                            <Label htmlFor="segment-structure-video-replace" className="m-0 cursor-pointer flex-1">
   835→                              <Button
   836→                                variant="outline"
   837→                                size="sm"
   838→                                disabled={videoUpload.isUploadingVideo}
   839→                                className="w-full h-8"
   840→                                asChild
   841→                              >
   842→                                <span>
   843→                                  {videoUpload.isUploadingVideo ? (
   844→                                    <>
   845→                                      <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 @[120px]:mr-1 animate-spin" />
   846→                                      <span className="hidden @[120px]:inline">{Math.round(videoUpload.uploadProgress)}%</span>
   847→                                    </>
   848→                                  ) : (
   849→                                    <>
   850→                                      <Video className="w-3 h-3 @[120px]:mr-1" />
   851→                                      <span className="hidden @[120px]:inline">Upload</span>
   852→                                    </>
   853→                                  )}
   854→                                </span>
   855→                              </Button>
   856→                            </Label>
   857→                            <Button
   858→                              variant="outline"
   859→                              size="sm"
   860→                              disabled={videoUpload.isUploadingVideo}
   861→                              onClick={() => videoUpload.setShowVideoBrowser(true)}
   862→                              className="flex-1 h-8"
   863→                            >
   864→                              <Images className="w-3 h-3 @[120px]:mr-1" />
   865→                              <span className="hidden @[120px]:inline">Browse</span>
   866→                            </Button>
   867→                          </div>
   868→                        </div>
   869→                      )}
   870→                    </div>
   871→                  </div>
   872→                )}
   873→
   874→                {/* Motion Strength */}
   875→                <div className="space-y-1.5">
   876→                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
   877→                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
   878→                      <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Strength:</Label>
   879→                      <FieldDefaultControls
   880→                        isUsingDefault={settings.structureMotionStrength === undefined}
   881→                        onUseDefault={() => onChange({ structureMotionStrength: undefined })}
   882→                        onSetAsDefault={onSaveFieldAsDefault ? () => handleSaveFieldAsDefault(
   883→                          'structureMotionStrength',
   884→                          settings.structureMotionStrength ?? structureVideoDefaults?.motionStrength ?? 1.2
   885→                        ) : undefined}
   886→                        isSaving={savingField === 'structureMotionStrength'}
   887→                      />
   888→                    </div>
   889→                    <span className="text-xs font-medium">
   890→                      {(settings.structureMotionStrength ?? structureVideoDefaults?.motionStrength ?? 1.2).toFixed(1)}x
   891→                    </span>
   892→                  </div>
   893→                  <Slider
   894→                    value={settings.structureMotionStrength ?? structureVideoDefaults?.motionStrength ?? 1.2}
   895→                    onValueChange={(value) => onChange({ structureMotionStrength: value })}
   896→                    min={0}
   897→                    max={2}
   898→                    step={0.1}
   899→                    className="w-full"
   900→                  />
   901→                  <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
   902→                    <span>0x</span>
   903→                    <span>1x</span>
   904→                    <span>2x</span>
   905→                  </div>
   906→                </div>
   907→
   908→                {/* Uni3C End Percent */}
   909→                {structureVideoType === 'uni3c' && (
   910→                  <div className="space-y-1.5">
   911→                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
   912→                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
   913→                        <Label className="text-xs font-medium">End Percent:</Label>
   914→                        <FieldDefaultControls
   915→                          isUsingDefault={settings.structureUni3cEndPercent === undefined}
   916→                          onUseDefault={() => onChange({ structureUni3cEndPercent: undefined })}
   917→                          onSetAsDefault={onSaveFieldAsDefault ? () => handleSaveFieldAsDefault(
   918→                            'structureUni3cEndPercent',
   919→                            settings.structureUni3cEndPercent ?? structureVideoDefaults?.uni3cEndPercent ?? 0.1
   920→                          ) : undefined}
   921→                          isSaving={savingField === 'structureUni3cEndPercent'}
   922→                        />
   923→                      </div>
   924→                      <span className="text-xs font-medium">
   925→                        {((settings.structureUni3cEndPercent ?? structureVideoDefaults?.uni3cEndPercent ?? 0.1) * 100).toFixed(0)}%
   926→                      </span>
   927→                    </div>
   928→                    <Slider
   929→                      value={settings.structureUni3cEndPercent ?? structureVideoDefaults?.uni3cEndPercent ?? 0.1}
   930→                      onValueChange={(value) => onChange({ structureUni3cEndPercent: value })}
   931→                      min={0}
   932→                      max={1}
   933→                      step={0.05}
   934→                      className="w-full"
   935→                    />
   936→                    <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
   937→                      <span>0%</span>
   938→                      <span>50%</span>
   939→                      <span>100%</span>
   940→                    </div>
   941→                  </div>
   942→                )}
   943→
   944→              </div>
   945→            )}
   946→          </div>
   947→
   948→          {/* LoRA Selector Modal */}
   949→          <LoraSelectorModal
   950→            isOpen={isLoraModalOpen}
   951→            onClose={() => setIsLoraModalOpen(false)}
   952→            loras={availableLoras}
   953→            onAddLora={handleLoraSelect}
   954→            onRemoveLora={handleRemoveLora}
   955→            onUpdateLoraStrength={handleLoraStrengthChange}
   956→            selectedLoras={(effectiveLoras).map(lora => {
   957→              const fullLora = availableLoras.find(l => l.id === lora.id || l.path === lora.path);
   958→              return {
   959→                ...fullLora,
   960→                "Model ID": lora.id,
   961→                Name: lora.name,
   962→                strength: lora.strength,
   963→              } as LoraModel & { strength: number };
   964→            })}
   965→            lora_type="Wan I2V"
   966→          />
   967→
   968→          {/* Structure Video Browser Modal - Timeline Mode Only */}
   969→          {isTimelineMode && (
   970→            <DatasetBrowserModal
   971→              isOpen={videoUpload.showVideoBrowser}
   972→              onOpenChange={videoUpload.setShowVideoBrowser}
   973→              resourceType="structure-video"
   974→              title="Browse Guidance Videos"
   975→              onResourceSelect={videoUpload.handleVideoResourceSelect}
   976→            />
   977→          )}
   978→        </CollapsibleContent>
   979→      </Collapsible>
   980→
   981→      {/* Submit Button */}
   982→      <Button
   983→        size="sm"
   984→        onClick={handleSubmit}
   985→        disabled={isSubmitting || !startImageUrl}
   986→        className="w-full gap-2"
   987→        variant={submitSuccess ? "outline" : "default"}
   988→      >
   989→        {isSubmitting ? (
   990→          <>
   991→            <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
   992→            <span>Generating...</span>
   993→          </>
   994→        ) : submitSuccess ? (
   995→          <>
   996→            <span className="text-green-600">✓</span>
   997→            <span>Task Created</span>
   998→          </>
   999→        ) : (
  1000→          <span>{buttonLabel || (isRegeneration ? 'Regenerate Segment' : 'Generate Segment')}</span>
  1001→        )}
  1002→      </Button>
  1003→
  1004→      {/* Restore Defaults / Save as Defaults Buttons */}
  1005→      {(onRestoreDefaults || onSaveAsShotDefaults) && (
  1006→        <div className="flex gap-2">
  1007→          {onRestoreDefaults && (
  1008→            <Button
  1009→              size="sm"
  1010→              variant="ghost"
  1011→              onClick={onRestoreDefaults}
  1012→              disabled={isSubmitting || isSavingDefaults}
  1013→              className="flex-1 h-7 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground gap-1"
  1014→            >
  1015→              <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
  1016→              Restore Defaults
  1017→            </Button>
  1018→          )}
  1019→          {onSaveAsShotDefaults && (
  1020→            <Button
  1021→              size="sm"
  1022→              variant="ghost"
  1023→              onClick={handleSaveAsShotDefaults}
  1024→              disabled={isSubmitting || isSavingDefaults}
  1025→              className="flex-1 h-7 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground gap-1"
  1026→            >
  1027→              {isSavingDefaults ? (
  1028→                <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
  1029→              ) : saveDefaultsSuccess ? (
  1030→                <span className="text-green-600">✓</span>
  1031→              ) : (
  1032→                <Save className="w-3 h-3" />
  1033→              )}
  1034→              {saveDefaultsSuccess ? 'Saved!' : 'Set as Shot Defaults'}
  1035→            </Button>
  1036→          )}
  1037→        </div>
  1038→      )}
  1039→    </div>

     6→import { Button } from '@/shared/components/ui/button';
     7→import { Input } from '@/shared/components/ui/input';
     8→import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger, TooltipProvider } from '@/shared/components/ui/tooltip';
     9→import { Loader2, Check, Film, Wand2, AlertTriangle, Trash2, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, X, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
    10→import { LoraManager } from '@/shared/components/LoraManager';

    12→import { cn } from '@/shared/lib/utils';
    13→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
    14→import { PortionSelection, formatTime } from '@/shared/components/VideoPortionTimeline';
    15→import { MotionPresetSelector, type BuiltinPreset } from '@/shared/components/MotionPresetSelector';

    18→import { BUILTIN_VACE_PRESET, VACE_FEATURED_PRESET_IDS } from '@/shared/lib/vaceDefaults';
